ruleTitle: PAGE 1 — Chapter Opening — Republic Day, Quote aur 4 Big Questions (PDF p.1)
conceptText: Yeh chapter hai The Constitution of India — An Introduction (Bharat ka Samvidhan — ek parichay) — NCERT Class 7 SST kitaab Exploring Society: India and Beyond (Part 1, Grade 7) ka Chapter 10. Yeh Democracy and Governance (Loktantra aur Shasan) theme ka chapter hai. 📷 Fig 10.1 — Glimpses from the Republic Day Parade (Republic Day parade ki jhalkiyan) — marching bands, vibrant displays aur tricolour ka manzar. 📷 Fig 10.1 — Republic Day parade ka ek aur nazara — forces ki dhumdhar marches har 26 January ko Delhi mein dikhti hain. 📷 Fig 10.1 — Parade ki jhalkiyan — is din hamara Constitution lagu (effective) hua tha, isliye yeh din itna khaas hai! I would like to point out that if we are able to act according to the Constitution which has been adopted..., I am sure we shall be able very soon to make our country great. This is a goal which is within our power to reach, but its realisation would require hard physical and mental labour and above all great moral regeneration. We have prepared a democratic Constitution. But the successful working of democratic institutions requires in those who have to work with them willingness to respect the viewpoint of others, capacity for compromise and accommodation. — — Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati (first President of India) Quote ka matlab simple shabdon mein: sirf Constitution likh dena kaafi nahi — uske hisaab se jeena padega. Desh ko great banane ke liye mehnat (physical aur mental labour) aur upar se moral regeneration (naive ki achhi roop mein dobara jagana) chahiye. Aur loktantrik institutions ko chalane ke liye doosron ke viewpoint ka samman, samjhauta (compromise) aur adjustment ki kshamata chahiye. 📌 BIG QUESTIONS — Is chapter ke 4 Bade Sawaal • Constitution kya hai, aur humein ek ki zaroorat kyun hai? • Bhartiya Constitution kaise taiyaar kiya gaya? • Hamare swatantrata sangharsh (freedom struggle) aur sabhyata-virasa (civilisational heritage) ne Constitution ko kaise prabhavit kiya? • Bharat ke Constitution ki mukhya visheshtaayein (key features) kya hain? Sattar (seventy) saal se zyada purani likhi gayi kitab hai, phir bhi aaj bhi relevant (saarhik) kyun hai?

text: Yeh Class 7 SST ka Chapter 10 kis topic par hai?
options: The Constitution of India — An Introduction
ans: The Constitution of India — An Introduction
explanation: Chapter 10 ka naam hai The Constitution of India — An Introduction — Bharat ke Samvidhan ka parichay. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh NCERT ki kitaab Exploring Society: India and Beyond (Part 1, Grade 7) ka chapter hai aur Democracy and Governance theme ke andar aata hai. Chapter ke 4 Big Questions isi par centred hain: kya hai, kaise bana, kis se prabhavit hua, aur kya features. Exam mein chapter ka poora framework inhi sawaalon par bana hai.

text: Is chapter kis theme (unit) ka hissa hai?
ans: Democracy and Governance
explanation: Yeh chapter Democracy and Governance (Loktantra aur Shasan) theme ka hissa hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Grade 7 ki is kitaab mein alag-alag themes hain — jaise India and the World, aur Democracy and Governance. Chapter 10 Constitution par hai, isliye naturally Democracy and Governance theme mein aata hai. Aage ke chapters bhi isi theme ke honge.

text: Chapter ke shuru mein quote kisne diya hai?
ans: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
explanation: Quote Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne diya hai — jo Bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati (first President of India) the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Constituent Assembly ke Chairman bhi the — yani Constitution banane wali sabhi ka sabse bada adhyaksh. Ek hi vyakti dono roles mein — pehle Assembly ka Chairman, phir desh ke pehle President. Quote par dhyaan dena: unhone Constitution ke theek se chalane par zor diya.

text: Rajendra Prasad ke anusaar desh ko great banane ke liye sabse upar kya chahiye?
options: Hard physical and mental labour aur upar se great moral regeneration
ans: Hard physical and mental labour aur upar se great moral regeneration
explanation: Prasad ji kehte hain: goal hamari pahunch mein hai, par uski realisation ke liye kathin sharirik aur maanasik mehnat aur sabse upar mahaan naishthik punarjagran (moral regeneration) chahiye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Quote ke do hisse hain: pehla — desh great ban sakta hai, par mehnat aur moral regeneration se; doosra — democratic institutions tabhi chalenge jab log doosron ki rai ka samman karein aur samjhauta kar sakein. Dono hisse exam mein aa sakte hain.

text: Democratic institutions ke successful working ke liye Rajendra Prasad ne kya maanga?
options: Willingness to respect the viewpoint of others, capacity for compromise and accommodation
ans: Willingness to respect the viewpoint of others, capacity for compromise and accommodation
explanation: Loktantrik sansthaayein tabhi safal chalti hain jab unme kaam karne walon mein doosron ke drishtikon ka samman karne ki ichchha, samajauta (compromise) aur adjust karne ki kshamata ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh line democracy ka core hai: sabki rai alag ho sakti hai, phir bhi milkar faisla lena. Compromise aur accommodation ke bina vidhayika (legislature) mein kuch bhi pass nahi hoga. Samvidhan ne bhi yahi sikhaya — sabko jagah di gayi.

text: CHITRA 10.1 (Fig 10.1) mein kya dikhaya gaya hai?
options: Glimpses from the Republic Day Parade
ans: Glimpses from the Republic Day Parade
explanation: Fig 10.1 mein Republic Day Parade ki jhalkiyan hain — marching bands, vibrant displays aur tricolour. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Republic Day har saal 26 January ko manaya jaata hai — kyunki isi din 1950 mein Constitution lagu hua tha. Parade mein Kartavya Path par tricolour lahraya jaata hai aur forces ki march hoti hai. Chapter isi maulik se shuru hota hai.

text: Bhartiya Constitution likhe jaane ke baare mein Big Question 4 kya kehta hai?
options: Yeh sattar (seventy) saal se zyada pehle likhi gayi hai, phir bhi aaj bhi relevant kyun hai?
Yeh abhi likhi ja rahi hai
ans: Yeh sattar (seventy) saal se zyada pehle likhi gayi hai, phir bhi aaj bhi relevant kyun hai?
explanation: Chotha Bada Sawaal: Constitution sattar saal se zyada purani likhi gayi hai — phir bhi aaj bhi saarhik (relevant) kyun hai? Yahi chapter ka asli sawaal hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1950 mein lagu hua Constitution aaj bhi chal raha hai — kyunki ise badla ja sakta hai (living document) aur uske values (nyay, samanta, svatantrata) hamesha ke liye hain. Chapter ke ant mein iska jawab milta hai.

text: Chapter ke 4 Big Questions mein se kaunsa sawaal NAHI hai?
options: Constitution kya hai aur zaroorat kyun hai?
Freedom struggle aur civilisational heritage ka prabhav kya raha?
Himalaya ki sabse oonchi choti kaunsi hai?

explanation: Himalaya wala sawaal is chapter mein nahi hai. Chaar bade sawaal: kya/kyun, kaise taiyaar hua, kis se prabhavit, aur key features + relevance. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chapter ka poora structure inhi 4 sawaalon ka jawab hai — isliye revision ke liye inhe yaad rakho: (1) meaning aur need, (2) banane ki prakriya, (3) influences, (4) features aur aaj ki relevance. Har section kisi ek sawaal ka jawab hai.

text: Dr. Rajendra Prasad ke baare mein kaunsa statement SAHI hai?
options: Woh Bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati the
Woh Drafting Committee ke Chairman the
ans: Woh Bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati the
explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati the — chapter opening quote unhi ki hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Confusion wala point: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Drafting Committee ke Chairman the, jabki Dr. Rajendra Prasad Constituent Assembly ke Chairman aur desh ke pehle President. Dono naam alag-alag roles ke saath yaad rakho — exam ka favourite hai.

text: Quote ke anusaar Constitution ka safal hona kis par nirbhar karta hai?
options: Us par amal karne par — mehnat, moral regeneration aur doosron ki rai ka samman
ans: Us par amal karne par — mehnat, moral regeneration aur doosron ki rai ka samman
explanation: Prasad ji ka kehna: agar hum apnaye hue Constitution ke hisaab se kaam karein toh hi desh jaldi great banega — yani amal (acting) sabse zaroori hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Constitution sirf kagaz nahi — uski asli taakat logon ke us par chalne mein hai. Isi liye quote shabd "act according to the Constitution" se shuru hota hai. Moral regeneration ka matlab: samaj ke andar imaandaari aur sadachar ki nayi jaagrukti.

text: Exploring Society: India and Beyond kaunsi class ki kitaab hai jismein yeh chapter hai?
ans: Class 7, Part 1
explanation: Yeh chapter Class 7 ki Part 1 kitaab Exploring Society: India and Beyond mein hai — Chapter 10. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: NCERT ki nayi series Exploring Society: India and Beyond Grade 7 ke liye hai. Isi series mein Grade 6 mein Constitution se jude concepts (jaise unity in diversity) padhe gaye the — is chapter mein baar-baar Grade 6 ki revision aayegi (LET US REMEMBER boxes).

ruleTitle: PAGE 2 — Kartavya Path ki Kahani — Helium Case aur Constitution ka Matlab (PDF p.2-3)
conceptText: Yeh ek sardi wali January ki subah ki kahani hai, Delhi mein — bilkul har Republic Day jaisi. Ma ki aawaaz ghar mein goonjti thi: "Uth jao! Waqt ho gaya, warna parade miss kar doge!" Papa pehle se uthe hue the — unhone television par Doordarshan on kar diya aur pukaara: "Kumar, Niharika, jaldi aao! Parade shuru ho gayi!" Bachche apni garam bistariyon se kood kar TV ke saamne aa gaye — Republic Day Parade ka ek pal bhi miss nahi karna chahte the. Shaan-daar marching bands, rangeen displays (vibrant displays) aur Kartavya Path par tricolour (teen rang ka jhanda) fehrane ka manzar poore kamre ko garv aur josh se bhar deta hai. Yeh din gehra mahatva rakhta hai — yeh 26 January 1950 ko Bhartiya Constitution ke lagu hone (coming into effect) ka din hai. Aur jo kitab tasveer mein dikh rahi hai — woh hamara Constitution hai. Isse mehfooz rakhne ke liye ise Parliament mein helium se bhare sheeshe ke dibbe (helium-filled glass case) mein atyanta saavdhaani se surakshit rakha gaya hai. 📷 Fig 10.2 — Bharat ka Samvidhan, Parliament mein helium se bhare sheeshe ke case mein atyanta saavdhaani se mehfooz — jaise koi khazana! ((Helium ek aisi gas hai jo paper ya ink ke saath react nahi karti — isi liye Constitution ko samay ke saath mehfooz rakhne mein madad karti hai.)) Par asal mein constitution hota kya hai, aur yeh itna zaroori kyun hai? 📌 LET US REMEMBER Yaad karo ki Grade 6 mein humne constitution shabd ka matlab dekha tha — ek aisa document jo kisi desh ke basic siddhant aur kanoon (basic principles and laws of a nation) tay karta hai. Teen logon ki chhoti groups mein banao aur desh ke constitution ke baare mein dimaag mein aane wale saare sawaal ki list banao. Agla hissa: Bhartiya Samvidhan woh document hai jiski hifazat karne ki saugaand (pledge) hamare mulk ke kai bade adhikari khaate hain. Rashtrapati (president) ise banaaye rakhne, surakshit karne aur bachaane (preserve, protect and defend) ki saugandh leta hai. Pradhan Mantri (prime minister), mantriton ki parishad (council of ministers) aur judges (nyayadhish) iske prabandhon (provisions) ka paalan karne ka vaada karte hain.

text: Kahani mein bachchon ke naam kya the jo parade dekhne uthe?
ans: Kumar aur Niharika
explanation: Kahani mein do bachche the — Kumar aur Niharika — jo Doordarshan par Republic Day Parade dekhne ke liye bistar se kood uthe. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Papa ne Doordarshan channel on kiya tha — Republic Day parade ka live prasaran purane zamane se Doordarshan par hota aaya hai. Yeh chapter story se shuru hota hai taaki Republic Day ko Constitution se joda ja sake — yani kahani ka asli point yeh hai ki 26 January Constitution ke lagu hone ka din hai.

text: Republic Day kis baat ka nishaan hai?
options: Bhartiya Constitution ka 26 January 1950 ko lagu hona
ans: Bhartiya Constitution ka 26 January 1950 ko lagu hona
explanation: Yeh din 26 January 1950 ko Bhartiya Constitution ke lagu hone ka nishaan hai — isi liye Republic Day manate hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Zara socho: azadi 15 August 1947 ko mili thi, par Constitution lagu 26 January 1950 ko hua. Beech ke do saal mein desh Constitution ke bina chal raha tha. Jab Constitution lagu hua, tab Bharat poore roop se ganatantra (republic) bana — isliye Republic Day.

text: Parade kis jagah tricolour fehra jaata hai (kahani ke anusaar)?
ans: Kartavya Path
explanation: Kahani mein Kartavya Path par tricolour fehrane ka zikr hai — marching bands aur displays ke saath. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kartavya Path pehle Rajpath ke naam se jaana jaata tha — Delhi ka woh rasta jahan har saal Republic Day parade hoti hai. Kahani mein "unfurling of the tricolour at Kartavya Path" ka poora manzar bayaan hua hai — yani jhanda fehrana (gale ko chadha kar kholna).

text: Hamara Constitution kahan mehfooz rakha gaya hai?
options: Parliament mein helium se bhare sheeshe ke case mein
National Museum mein loha ke safe mein
ans: Parliament mein helium se bhare sheeshe ke case mein
explanation: Constitution ko Parliament mein helium se bhare sheeshe ke dibbe (glass case) mein atyanta saavdhaani se mehfooz rakha gaya hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fig 10.2 mein yehi dikhaya gaya hai. Constitution kagaz par likha document hai — kagaz aur ink samay ke saath kharab ho sakte hain, isliye aisa protective arrangement zaroori tha. Crossword clue bhi isi par hai: "The gas used to preserve the original Constitution safely" — jawab helium!

text: Helium gas Constitution ki hifazat mein kaise madad karti hai?
options: Yeh gas paper ko rangti hai
Yeh paper ya ink ke saath react nahi karti
Yeh gas ko sukha deti hai
ans: Yeh paper ya ink ke saath react nahi karti
explanation: Helium ek inert (sadharan) gas hai — yeh paper ya ink ke saath react nahi karti, isliye Constitution ko samay ke saath mehfooz rakhne mein madad karti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Jo cheez react nahi karti, woh kharab nahi karti — simple chemistry! Oxygen aur nami kagaz ko peela karti hai, par helium bilkul neutral hai. Isliye original Constitution aaj bhi nearly 76 saal baad bhi achhi haalat mein hai. Exam mein yeh detail aati hai — helium ka role yaad rakho.

text: Rashtrapati Constitution ke liye kya saugandh (oath) leta hai?
options: Use banaaye rakhne, surakshit karne aur bachaane ki — preserve, protect and defend
ans: Use banaaye rakhne, surakshit karne aur bachaane ki — preserve, protect and defend
explanation: Rashtrapati Constitution ko preserve (banaaye rakhna), protect (surakshit karna) aur defend (bachaana) — teeno ki saugandh leta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Teen shabd exam ke liye golden hain: preserve, protect, defend. Aur dusre officials — PM, council of ministers aur judges — iske provisions (dhaavo/prabandh) ka paalan karne ka vaada karte hain. Yani har bada adhikari Constitution se bandha hua hai.

text: Pradhan Mantri, mantriton ki parishad aur judges Constitution ke prati kya vaada karte hain?
options: Iske prabandhon (provisions) ka paalan karne ka
ans: Iske prabandhon (provisions) ka paalan karne ka
explanation: PM, council of ministers aur judges Constitution ke provisions (prabandhon) ka paalan (follow) karne ka vaada karte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek tarah se poore shasan-tantra ka har bada adhikari Constitution ko apna margdarshak maan kar saugandh leta hai. Rashtrapati ki oath alag hai (preserve-protect-defend), baakiyon ki paalan ki. Yeh antar exam mein aa sakta hai.

text: Grade 6 mein humne constitution shabd ka kya matlab padha tha (LET US REMEMBER)?
options: Ek kitab jo kahaniyan batati hai
Ek document jo desh ke basic principles aur kanoon tay karta hai
ans: Ek document jo desh ke basic principles aur kanoon tay karta hai
explanation: Grade 6 ka lesson: constitution ek aisa document jo kisi desh ke basic principles aur laws tay karta (lays down) hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Word-by-word yaad karo: a document that lays down the basic principles and laws of a nation. Chapter 10 isi definition ko aage detail mein kholta hai — kya-kya contain karta hai constitution. LET US REMEMBER box class 6 se 7 ka pul (bridge) banata hai.

text: Chapter ki opening story ka main message kya hai?
options: Republic Day ka asli matlab Constitution ka lagu hona hai
ans: Republic Day ka asli matlab Constitution ka lagu hona hai
explanation: Story ka asli point: Republic Day ka utsav Constitution ke lagu hone se juda hai — parade, jhanda aur tricolour iske bahar roop hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: NCERT aksar chapter ko rozbhar kahani se shuru karti hai taaki abstract concept (constitution) ko bachchon ke anubhav se joda ja sake. Kahani mein family, Doordarshan aur Kartavya Path — sab familiar cheezein hain jo Constitution tak le jaati hain.

text: Doordarshan kya hai jo kahani mein mention hua?
ans: Sarkar ka television channel
explanation: Doordarshan sarkar ka television channel hai jahan se Papa ne parade dikhaayi — India ka sabse purana broadcaster. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kahani mein Papa ne television par Doordarshan on kiya tha. Republic Day ki parade ka traditional live telecast Doordarshan par hota hai. Yeh detail story ke time period aur setting ko realistic banati hai.

text: Original Constitution ki hifazat ke liye kaunsa gas use hota hai?
ans: Helium
explanation: Helium — kyunki yeh paper aur ink dono ke saath react nahi karti, isliye document ko mehfooz rakhti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Helium halki aur non-reactive gas hai — isi liye ise balloons mein bhi bharte hain! Chapter ke ant mein crossword ka ek clue yehi hai: "The gas used to preserve the original Constitution safely" —jawab helium. Fig 10.2 aur yeh dono mila kar ek pakka exam point ban jaata hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 3 — Constitution Kya Hai? — Kabaddi Rulebook Wali Kahani (PDF p.3-4)
conceptText: Simple jawaab: constitution ek aisa document hai jo kisi desh ke basic principles aur kanoon ko spasht roop se bayan karta hai (spells out a nation is basic principles and laws). Yeh bayan karta hai: • sarkar ke teen organs (legislature, executive aur judiciary) ka framework — unki bhoomikaayein aur zimmedariyaan (roles and responsibilities); • teeno organs ke beech checks and balances — taaki nyay, zimmedari aur jawabdehi (fairness, responsibility and accountability) sure ho; • nagrikon ke adhikaar aur farz (rights and duties of the citizens); • des ki deerg kaalik lakshya aur aakankshaon (long-term goals and aspirations) ka outline. 📌 Why do we need a constitution? — Humein Constitution ki zaroorat kyun hai? 📌 LET US EXPLORE — Kabaddi ka Rulebook Socho ki tumhari school ki team state-level kabaddi tournament ke final mein pahunchi hai. Saamne wali team bahut strong hai — do saal lagataar jeet chuki hai aur ab hat-trick ka iraada rakhti hai. Match chal raha hai, aur tumhari team ke ek player ne dusri team ke ek player ko out kar diya hai — phir vivad (dispute) ho gaya! Dusri team ki player ka kehna hai ki woh apni team ke area mein pehle hi pahunch chuki thi jab usse pakda gaya. Lekin referee ne dekha ki woh sach mein out thi. Vivad shanti se suljhane ke liye (to settle the dispute amicably) referee ne apni chhoti si official rulebook nikali. Team captains referee ke saath mil kar rules dekhte hain, aur phir sab sehmati se maante hain ki player sach mein out thi — aur tumhari team state-level trophy jeet gayi! Apne group mein discuss karo: agar woh official rulebook hota hi nahi jo referee aur captains dekh saktein, toh kya hota? Sabko rulebook maanna sure karne ke liye kya chahiye? Aur agar captains rulebook dekhne ke liye maanne hi nahi maante toh kya hota? Ek aisa game socho jo tum aksar khelte ho aur uske rules ki list banao. Har group apne rules baaki class ko sunayega, discussion hoga, aur sabki sehmati (consensus) se game ke common rules banenge. Sabki sehmati tak pahunchne mein kaunsi mushkilein aati hain? Aur phir bada sawaal: desh ka rulebook kya ho sakta hai? Woh kaise bana? — Hamara Constitution desh ke liye kuch aisa hi rulebook hai!

text: Constitution ka simple definition kya hai?
options: Ek document jo desh ke basic principles aur kanoon ko spasht bayan karta hai
ans: Ek document jo desh ke basic principles aur kanoon ko spasht bayan karta hai
explanation: Constitution woh document hai jo desh ke basic principles aur laws ko spells out karta hai — yani spasht roop se likh kar bayan karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Definition ke do keywords: document, aur basic principles + laws. Yeh raja ki farmanshon se alag hai — aisa likhit document jo sabke liye same rules deta hai. Crossword clue bhi isi par hai: "The document that lays out the rules and laws of a country" — jawab constitution.

text: Constitution sarkar ke kaunse teen organs ka framework bayan karta hai?
ans: Legislature, executive aur judiciary
explanation: Teen organs: legislature (vidhayika — kanoon banati hai), executive (kaaryapaalika — kanoon lagu karti hai) aur judiciary (nyaypaalika — nyay karti hai) — inki roles aur responsibilities Constitution mein likhi hoti hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Teen organs ka triangle yaad rakho: banane wala, chalane wala, aur faisla karne wala. Constitution in teeno ka poora framework deta hai — kaun kaise banta hai, kya kaam karega. Yeh Grade 6 se aaya hua concept hai jo is chapter mein revist hota hai.

text: Constitution mein teeno organs ke beech kya sure hota hai?
options: Checks and balances — nyay, zimmedari aur jawabdehi ke liye
Ek organ ka sab kuch chalana
ans: Checks and balances — nyay, zimmedari aur jawabdehi ke liye
explanation: Constitution teeno organs ke beech checks and balances rakhta hai — taaki fairness (nyay), responsibility (zimmedari) aur accountability (jawabdehi) sure ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Checks and balances ka matlab: koi ek organ apni had se bahar nahi ja sakta — doosre organs use rok aur sudhaar sakte hain. Jaise umpire game ko fair rakhta hai, waise hi yeh system sarkar ko fair rakhta hai. Isi se kisi ek vyakti ya office ke haath mein poora power nahi aata.

text: Constitution nagrikon ke baare mein kya bayan karta hai?
options: Unke adhikaar aur farz — rights aur duties
ans: Unke adhikaar aur farz — rights aur duties
explanation: Constitution nagrikon ke rights (adhikaar) aur duties (farz) — dono bayan karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh dono taraph ka vaada hai: samvidhan nagrik ko kuch adhikaar deta hai (jaise shiksha, samanta) aur kuch farz bhi deta hai (jaise samvidhan ka samman karna). Fundamental Rights aur Fundamental Duties — dono is chapter mein aage detail se aayenge. Bas abhi itna yaad rakho ki constitution = rights + duties dono.

text: Kabaddi wali LET US EXPLORE story mein vivad kya tha?
options: Ek player is baat par sehmat nahi thi ki woh out hui thi
ans: Ek player is baat par sehmat nahi thi ki woh out hui thi
explanation: Vivad yeh tha ki dusri team ki player kehne lagi — main toh pakde jaane se pehle hi apne team area mein pahunch chuki thi, jabki referee ne dekha ki woh sach mein out thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kabaddi mein rule hai ki raider wapas apne area tak pahunchna chahiye. Story ka point: jab rule spasht ho aur sabke paas official rulebook ho, toh vivad shanti se sulajhta hai — referee aur captains ne rulebook dekhi aur faisla man liya. Wahi desh ke liye Constitution karta hai!

text: Kabaddi ke vivad mein referee ne kya nikala?
ans: Chhoti si official rulebook
explanation: Referee ne apni chhoti si official rulebook nikali — captains ke saath rules dekhe, aur sab sehmat hue ki player out thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Rulebook hi woh cheez thi jisne vivad ko amicably (bina ladai-jhagde) solve kiya. Bina rulebook ke? Shayad jeet-jhooth ka faisla nahi hota, jhagda hota. Yehi saboot deta hai ki kisi bhi khel — ya desh — ke liye sabko manane wale written rules chahiye.

text: Kabaddi story se hum desh ke liye kya seekhte hain?
options: Desh ka rulebook Constitution hai — jise sabko maanna padta hai
ans: Desh ka rulebook Constitution hai — jise sabko maanna padta hai
explanation: Kitaab kehti hai: desh ka rulebook kya ho sakta hai? — hamara Constitution, desh ke liye kuch aisa hi rulebook hai jo sabko maanna padta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Analogy simple hai: jaise game ke rules sab players maante hain, waise desh ke rules (Constitution) sab citizens aur sarkar maante hain. Bina common rules ke na game chal sakta hai, na desh. Isliye har desh ko constitution ki zaroorat hoti hai — yehi Q1 ka jawab hai.

text: Story mein saamne wali team ka record kya tha?
options: Do saal lagataar jeet chuki thi, ab hat-trick ka iraada
ans: Do saal lagataar jeet chuki thi, ab hat-trick ka iraada
explanation: Saamne wali team strong thi — do saal lagataar tournament jeet chuki thi aur ab hat-trick (lagataar teesri jeet) ka iraada rakhti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Story mein strong opponent ka hona important hai — vivad itni hi badi team ke saath hua, phir bhi rulebook ne fair faisla karwaya. Yani rules bade-bade players ke liye bhi same hote hain. Desh mein bhi aisa hi hai: jitna bhi powerful vyakti ho, Constitution ke saamne sab barabar.

text: Apne game ke rules banate waqt sabki sehmati (consensus) tak pahunchne mein kya difficulty aati hai?
options: Sab apne apne rules chahte hain — common rules par agree karna mushkil hota hai
ans: Sab apne apne rules chahte hain — common rules par agree karna mushkil hota hai
explanation: Mushkil yeh ki har apne apne rules chahta hai — sabki sehmati se ek common set banana aasaan nahi hota. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yehi challenge Constituent Assembly ne bhi face kiya tha — India jaise diverse desh mein har region, samaj aur vichaar ka apna nazariya tha. Phir bhi lagbhag 3 saal ki debate-dharm ke baad sab sehmati se Constitution bana. Isliye Class 7 activity mein bhi consensus banane ki prakriya karwai gayi hai.

text: Constitution des ke lakshya aur aakankshaon ke baare mein kya deta hai?
options: Deerg kaalik lakshya aur aakankshaon (long-term goals aur aspirations) ka outline
ans: Deerg kaalik lakshya aur aakankshaon (long-term goals aur aspirations) ka outline
explanation: Constitution des ki deerg kaalik lakshya aur aakankshaon ka outline deta hai — yani des lambe samay mein kya banana chahta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Jaise Equality, Justice — yeh sirf aaj ke rules nahi, kal ke sapne hain. Constitution ek vision document bhi hai. Isi se aage jaakar Directive Principles of State Policy judte hain — jo des ke bade goals hain (jaise sabki achhi standard of living).

text: Constitution ke 4 main contents mein se kaunsa NAHI hai?
ans: Cricket team ka selection rules
explanation: Cricket team ka selection Constitution ka content nahi! Baaki teeno — organs ka framework, checks and balances, rights-duties — sab Constitution mein hain (plus long-term goals ka outline). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chaar cheezein ek saath yaad karo: (1) teen organs ka framework, (2) checks and balances, (3) citizens ke rights-duties, (4) des ke goals ka outline. Yeh list exam mein "constitution kya contain karta hai" ke roop mein seedha aata hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 4 — Rulebook Se Desh Tak — 25 Parts, Values aur Sachidananda Sinha (PDF p.4-5)
conceptText: Jaise tumhari textbook mein bahut se sections aur chapters hain, waise hi Bhartiya Samvidhan mein 25 parts aur 12 schedules hain. Har part ke andar sections hote hain. Yeh duniya ka sabse bada likhit samvidhan (world largest written constitution) hai. Jab yeh lagu hua tha (1950), tab ismein 22 Parts aur 8 schedules the. (In numbers ko yaad rakhna zaroori nahi — par socho, 1950 ke baad yeh badhe kyun?) Constitution ke basic rules aur principles tay karte hain ki kaisi sarkar hogi, woh kaise banegi aur kaise kaam karegi. Ismein woh kai principles bhi hain jo humne pichle chapter mein dekhe the — jaise legislature, executive aur judiciary kaise bante hain aur kaise kaam karte hain. Constitution misaal ke taur par yeh bhi batata hai ki kanoon kaise banaaye aur laagu kiye jaate hain, executive kaun chunta hai, judiciary kaise banti hai, aur nagrikon ke kya adhikaar aur farz hain. Kai samvidhanon mein — samet Bhartiya Samvidhan mein bhi — woh values aur ideals bhi likhe jaate hain jin par des pratibaddh hai — misaal ke taur par sab ke liye samanta aur nyay (equality and justice for all), bhaichara (fraternity), bahulvaad (pluralism) aur svatantrata (freedom). Darasal, yehi values aur ideals aksar samvidhan ke kanoon aur siddhanton ki neev (basis) ka kaam karte hain. 📌 MOSTLY SAARE CONSTITUTIONS MEIN KYA HOTA HAI Constitution | Values aur ideals of a society (samaj ke moolya) | Rights aur duties of citizens (adhikaar aur farz) Structure aur formation of the government (sarkar ka dhancha) | Political system (raajnietik vyavastha) Functions of different parts of the government (organs ke kaam) | Guiding principles for government (margdarshak siddhant) 📌 Writing the Constitution of India — Samvidhan Likhne ki Shuruaat I wish your labours success, and invoke Divine blessings that your proceedings may be marked not only by good sense, public spirit, and genuine patriotism, but also by wisdom, toleration, justice, and fairness to all; and above all with a vision which may restore India to her pristine glory, and give her a place of honour and equality amongst the great nations of the world. — — Dr. Sachidananda Sinha, samvidhan lekhan prakriya ki shuruaat mein Constituent Assembly ke President Ek taraf British hukumat se azaadi ki ladaai (struggle for independence) chal rahi thi — aur saath hi zaroorat thi ki hum apne aap ko shasan (govern) karne ki planning shuru karein. Bharat jaise bade, saanskritik roop se vividh (culturally diverse) aur complex des mein kaun-kaun se bade sawaalon ke jawaab dene the: • Humare paas kis tarah ki sarkar honi chahiye? (What type of government should we have?) • Kaun se rules aur principles humein margdarshan dein? • Vote dene ka adhikaar kis ko hona chahiye? • Vivadon ka faisla kaise hona chahiye?

text: Bhartiya Samvidhan mein kitne parts aur schedules HAI (abhi)?
ans: 25 parts aur 12 schedules
explanation: Aaj ke samay mein Bhartiya Samvidhan mein 25 parts aur 12 schedules hain — har part ke andar sections hote hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: DONOT MISS OUT box ke anusaar yeh duniya ka sabse bada likhit constitution hai. 1950 mein lagu hote waqt yeh sirf 22 parts aur 8 schedules tha — numbers badhe kyun? Kyunki samay ke saath naye subjects (jaise education, environment, local government) jodne ki zaroorat padi. Yeh isliye badha kyunki Constitution ek living document hai!

text: Samvidhan lagu hote samay (1950) mein kitne parts aur schedules the?
ans: 22 aur 8
explanation: 1950 mein Constitution ke 22 Parts aur 8 schedules the — ab 25 parts aur 12 schedules hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Book kehti hai numbers yaad rakhna zaroori nahi — par logic samajhna zaroori hai: parts aur schedules tab badhte hain jab naye kshetra jodne padte hain (Fundamental Duties ka Part IV-A 1976 mein juda, Panchayati Raj 1992 mein). Numbers ka badhna hi saboot hai ki Constitution badalta raha hai.

text: Bhartiya Samvidhan ka khaas status kya hai (duniya mein)?
options: Duniya ka sabse bada likhit samvidhan
ans: Duniya ka sabse bada likhit samvidhan
explanation: Bhartiya Samvidhan duniya ka sabse bada likhit samvidhan (world largest written constitution) hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Likhit (written) shabd pe dhyaan do — sabhi rules ek document mein likhe hue hain, muh-zaubaani nahi. Iski lambaai ki wajah: India ki diversity, history aur har hisse ko detail mein cover karna. DO NOT MISS OUT box kehta hai ki jaise textbook mein sections-chapters hain, waise Constitution mein parts-schedules.

text: Constitution ke basic rules aur principles kya tay karte hain?
options: Kaisi sarkar hogi, kaise banegi aur kaise kaam karegi
ans: Kaisi sarkar hogi, kaise banegi aur kaise kaam karegi
explanation: Constitution ke basic rules tay karte hain ki kaisi sarkar hogi, woh kaise banegi (formed) aur kaise kaam karegi (function). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yehi asli taakat hai: sarkar apni marzi se nahi, Constitution ke rules se banti hai aur chalti hai. Ismein legislature-executive-judiciary ke banna aur chalana, kanoon banana, executive kaun chunega — sab likha hai. Jaise game shuru hone se pehle rules set ho jaate hain.

text: Samvidhan kya-kya describe karta hai (misal ke taur par)?
options: Kanoon kaise bante-laagu hote hain, executive kaun chunta hai, judiciary kaise banti hai, citizens ke rights-duties kya hain
ans: Kanoon kaise bante-laagu hote hain, executive kaun chunta hai, judiciary kaise banti hai, citizens ke rights-duties kya hain
explanation: Constitution batata hai: kanoon kaise banaaye aur laagu kiye jaate hain, executive kaun chunta hai, judiciary kaise banti hai, aur nagrikon ke kya rights aur duties hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh list pichle chapter (Grade 6, Government chapter) se jude concepts ko aage badhati hai. Yaad rakho: Constitution sirf sarkar ka dhancha nahi — nagrik aur sarkar ke rishte ka poora dhancha hai. Har policy yahi se nikalti hai.

text: Samvidhan mein likhe jaane wale values aur ideals kaunse hain (chapter ke anusaar)?
options: Sab ke liye samanta aur nyay, bhaichara, bahulvaad aur svatantrata
ans: Sab ke liye samanta aur nyay, bhaichara, bahulvaad aur svatantrata
explanation: Values aur ideals: equality aur justice for all, fraternity (bhaichara), pluralism (bahulvaad) aur freedom (svatantrata). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fraternity = bhaichara; pluralism = alag-alag vichaaron-taakaton ko sammann dena. Book kehti hai ki yehi values aksar constitution ke kanoon aur principles ki basis (nev) ka kaam karti hain. Aage Preamble mein yeh values phir se mileage — wahan Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity ke roop mein!

text: Bhartiya Samvidhan kis desh ke liye "cornerstone" (mooj ki haddi jaisi neev) tha?
ans: Swatantr Bharat ke liye
explanation: Constitution swatantr Bharat ki neev (cornerstone) tha — azaad des ki sabse pehli aur sabse badi dhaam. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Cornerstone ka matlab: jaise building ki sabse important nevali patthar. Swatantrata ke turant baad des ko chalane ke liye rules chahiye the — aur woh rules hi Constitution bane. Isliye freedom struggle ke leaders Constitution banane mein itne involved the.

text: Sachidananda Sinha kaun the jinaka quote chapter mein hai?
options: Constituent Assembly ke President — samvidhan lekhan ki shuruaat mein
Ek freedom fighter jo Assembly mein nahi the
ans: Constituent Assembly ke President — samvidhan lekhan ki shuruaat mein
explanation: Dr. Sachidananda Sinha samvidhan lekhan prakriya ki shuruaat mein Constituent Assembly ke President the — unhone Assembly ko aashirwad diya tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Confuse na hon: Sinha ji temporary/starting President the — baad mein Dr. Rajendra Prasad Assembly ke Chairman bane. Sinha ji ki duaa mein khaas shabd: good sense, public spirit, patriotism, wisdom, toleration, justice, fairness to all — aur India ko world ke great nations mein samman ki jagah milna.

text: Sinha ji ke quote mein unhone kis baat ki kaamna ki?
options: Assembly ki kaaryvaahi par buddhi, sahishnuta, nyay aur sab ke prati fairness
ans: Assembly ki kaaryvaahi par buddhi, sahishnuta, nyay aur sab ke prati fairness
explanation: Sinha ji ne kaamna ki Assembly ki karyvaahi mein good sense, public spirit, genuine patriotism, wisdom, toleration, justice aur fairness to all ho — aur India ko punar uski praacheen mahima (pristine glory) mile. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Quote do hisso mein hai: Assembly ke liye values (wisdom-toleration-justice-fairness) aur des ke liye lakshya (pristine glory aur great nations mein barabar ka samman). Yeh bata raha hai ki Constitution banane ka kaam sirf kanoon likhna nahi, ek tapasya thi.

text: Constitution banne se pehle Bharat ke saamne kaunsa sawaal NAHI tha?
options: Vote ka adhikaar kis ko mile?
ans: Railway kitni tez chale?
explanation: Railway wala sawaal nahi tha. Asli sawaal the: kaisi sarkar, kaun se rules-principles, kis ko vote ka adhikaar, vivadon ka faisla kaise. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh sawaal tab uthe jab British hukumat se azaadi ki ladaai chal rahi thi aur khud ko govern karne ki planning shuru karni thi. Bharat bada aur culturally diverse des hai — isliye itne sawaal. Inhi sawaalon ke jawaab dene ke liye Constituent Assembly bana.

text: Constitution mein kaunse values aaksar kanoon aur siddhanton ki basis ka kaam karte hain?
options: Values aur ideals — jaise samanta aur nyay
ans: Values aur ideals — jaise samanta aur nyay
explanation: Darasal yehi values aur ideals — samanta, nyay, fraternity, pluralism, freedom — aksar samvidhan ke kanoon aur siddhanton ki basis ka kaam karte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Iska matlab: pehle values decide hui, phir unhi values ko laagu karne ke liye kanoon bane. Values like samanta (equality) seedha Article 14 (Equality before law) ban gayi. Yani Constitution ke andar ek thinking system hai — ideals upar, laws neeche, dono jude hue.

ruleTitle: PAGE 5 — Constituent Assembly — Samvidhan Kaise Banaya Gaya (PDF p.6)
conceptText: Inhi aur kai sawaalon ke jawaab dene ke liye ek Constituent Assembly (Samvidhan Sabha) banayi gayi — 1946 mein, shuruaat mein 389 members ke saath (baad mein, Bharat ke vibhajan (Partition of India) ke baad, yeh ghatakar 299 ho gaye), jinmein 15 mahilayein (women) thi. Yeh members Bharat ke vividh kshetron (regions), peson (professions) aur samajik samuhon (social groups) ko represent karte the. 📌 How was our Constitution developed? — Kaise bana hamara Samvidhan? Bhartiya Samvidhan Constituent Assembly dwara lagbhag teen saal (almost three years) ki avadhi mein develop aur likha gaya. • 9 December 1946 — Constituent Assembly bani; iske members pranton ki vidhayikaon (provincial legislative assemblies) dwara chune gaye — jinke members khud, apne aap mein, logon dwara chune gaye the (that is, indirectly, aam logon ki awaaz pahunchti thi). • Dr. Rajendra Prasad — Constituent Assembly ke Chairman rahe. • 26 November 1949 — drafting ka kaam poora hua aur Constitution of India ke roop mein adopt (apnaaya) gaya. • 26 January 1950 — yeh document lagu (came into effect) hua — isi din ko hum har saal Republic Day ke roop mein manate hain. Samvidhan ka shuruaati text (initial text) ek Drafting Committee ne taiyaar kiya, jiski adhyakshata (chair) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar — ek pramukh samaj sudharak (eminent social reformer) aur swatantr Bharat ke pehle Law and Justice minister — karte the. 📷 Fig 10.3 — Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (baithay hue, beech mein) Drafting Committee ke kuchh aur members ke saath — jinhone samvidhan ka initial text taiyaar kiya.

text: Constituent Assembly kab aur kitne members ke saath bani?
options: 1946 mein, shuruaat mein 389 members ke saath
ans: 1946 mein, shuruaat mein 389 members ke saath
explanation: Constituent Assembly 1946 mein 389 members ke saath bani — Partition ke baad yeh 299 reh gaye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Numbers ka sequence yaad rakho: 389 (1946, shuruaat) → 299 (Partition ke baad, kyunki kuch areas Pakistan chale gaye) → 15 women. Partition 1947 mein hua tha — Assembly tabhi sikudhi. Yeh dates-numbers wala MCQ exam ka pakka hai.

text: Constituent Assembly ke members kaun chunte the?
options: Pranton ki vidhayikaon ke members — jo khud logon dwara chune gaye the
ans: Pranton ki vidhayikaon ke members — jo khud logon dwara chune gaye the
explanation: Assembly ke members prant (province) ki vidhayikaon dwara chune gaye — aur woh vidhayikayein khud logon dwara chuni gayi thi — yani janata ki awaaz indirectly pahunchi thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do-step ka chunav tha: log → provincial legislative assemblies → Constituent Assembly. Iska matlab Constitution ke makers ki ijaadat janata se aayi thi — Constitution "by the people" tha. Isi se Preamble shuru hota hai: WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA!

text: Bharat ke vibhajan (Partition) ke baad Assembly ke members kitne ho gaye?
explanation: Partition ke baad members 299 ho gaye — shuruaat mein 389 the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1947 ka Partition India ko todta hua Pakistan banaya — aur Constituent Assembly se bhi kuch areas nikal gaye (jo Pakistan chale gaye). Yeh historical ghatna Constitution-making ko bhi prabhavit karta rahi. 15 women hamesha 299 mein shamil the — Partition unki sankhya nahi badli.

text: Constituent Assembly mein kitni mahilayein this?
explanation: Assembly mein 15 mahilayein this — jaise Begum Aizaz Rasul (jinaka quote aage chapter mein aayega). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1946 mein 15 women hona us zamane ke liye badi baat thi — duniya ke kai deson mein auraton ko vote ka adhikaar nahi tha! Bhartiya Assembly mein women apni awaaz lekar aayi. Begum Aizaz Rasul ne 22 November 1949 ko women ki samanta par bhashan diya tha — jo is chapter mein quote hua hai.

text: Constituent Assembly kab bani (exact date)?
ans: 9 December 1946
explanation: Constituent Assembly 9 December 1946 ko bani — azaadi se pehle hi! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Dates ki chain yaad karo: 9 Dec 1946 (Assembly bani) → 15 Aug 1947 (azaadi) → 26 Nov 1949 (Constitution adopted) → 26 Jan 1950 (Constitution lagu, Republic Day). Constitution ki likhai azaadi se pehle shuru ho gayi thi — planning pehle se chal rahi thi, isi liye 1946 mein Assembly bani.

text: Constituent Assembly ke Chairman kaun the?
ans: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Constituent Assembly ke Chairman the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Roles ka confusion sabse common galti hai! Sachidananda Sinha shuruaati President the, phir Rajendra Prasad Chairman/President bane (aur desh ke pehle Rashtrapati bhi), aur B.R. Ambedkar Drafting Committee ke Chairman the. Teen alag roles — teen alag log!

text: Samvidhan kab adopt kiya gaya (poora hua)?
ans: 26 November 1949
explanation: Drafting ka kaam 26 November 1949 ko poora hua aur samvidhan Constitution of India ke roop mein adopt hua. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 26 November ko Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) ke roop mein manaya jaata hai — kyunki isi din Constitution adopt hua. Do mahine baad 26 January 1950 ko woh lagu hua. Adopt karna = final roop mein apna lena; lagu hona = chalu hona. Yeh antar exam mein puchte hain!

text: Constitution kab lagu (came into effect) hua?
ans: 26 January 1950
explanation: Constitution 26 January 1950 ko lagu hua — isliye hum yeh din Republic Day manate hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ise "purna swaraj" din se bhi joda jaata hai — 26 January 1930 ko Congress ne Purna Swaraj ka sankalp diya tha, isi yaad mein yeh tareekh chuni gayi thi. Constitution ke lagu hote hi Bharat ganatantra (republic) bana — rashtra ke pramukh chune hue, virasat mein nahi mile hue.

text: Drafting Committee (jo samvidhan ka initial text taiyaar karta tha) kiske adhyakshatta mein tha?
ans: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
explanation: Drafting Committee ke Chairman Dr. B.R. Ambedkar the — pramukh samaj sudharak aur swatantr Bharat ke pehle Law and Justice minister. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ambedkar ji ko isi kaam ke liye "Father of the Indian Constitution" bhi kaha jaata hai. Unki team ne samvidhan ka initial text likha — jis par Assembly ne lagbhag 3 saal tak debate ki. Fig 10.3 mein unhe Drafting Committee ke members ke beech (baithay hue, beech mein) dekh sakte ho.

text: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ke baare mein book kya kehti hai?
options: Woh ek pramukh samaj sudharak aur swatantr Bharat ke pehle Law and Justice minister the
ans: Woh ek pramukh samaj sudharak aur swatantr Bharat ke pehle Law and Justice minister the
explanation: Book kehti hai: Ambedkar eminent social reformer (pramukh samaj sudharak) aur swatantr Bharat ke pehle Law and Justice minister the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Social reformer ka unka kaam — caste discrimination ke khilaaf ladaai aur sabki samanta — unke samvidhan ke design ko prabhavit karta raha. Samvidhan ke Article 14 (Equality before law) jaise roop unhi ki soch ke roop mein hain. Law minister hote hue unhone Constitution draft kiya — double role!

text: Samvidhan ko taiyaar hone mein kitna samay laga?
ans: Lagbhag teen saal (almost three years)
explanation: Samvidhan Constituent Assembly dwara lagbhag teen saal ki avadhi mein develop aur likha gaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tees saal nahi — TEEN saal! 9 Dec 1946 se 26 Nov 1949 tak. Yeh samay debates, discussions, committees aur drafts mein gaya — har shabd par baithke baith baithi hui. Isi liye Constitution itna detail aur balanced hai. Time period ka MCQ aata hai — "almost three years" yaad rakho.

ruleTitle: PAGE 6 — Samvidhan Ko Kisne Prabhavit Kiya — Freedom Movement (PDF p.7)
conceptText: 📌 LET US EXPLORE — Apne kshetra ke log Chhote groups mein, apne kshetra (region) ke un logon ke naam pata lagane ki koshish karo jo samvidhan banane mein hissa le sakte the. Yeh jaankari kahan se milegi? Kaise sources use karoge? Madal (Hint): School ya local library ki kitabein dekho. Apne teacher, maa-baap aur mohalle ke buzurgon se poochho. Sansad ki website explore karo. Jabki samvidhan Constituent Assembly ne banaya, us par kai prabhav (influences) rahe: • Bhartiya swatantrata andolan (Indian freedom movement) ke anubhav, vichaar aur ideals — ek mahatvapurna prabhav; • Bharat ki sabhyata-virasa aur sanskriti (civilisational heritage and culture) — bhi ek key role mein; • Doosre deshon ke samvidhanon se upyogi seekh (useful learnings) — bhi vichar ki gayi. 📌 Influence of the Indian Freedom Movement — Swatantrata Andolan ka Asar Bhartiya swatantrata sangharsh ke kai key ideals aur values samvidhan mein enshrine (pavitra roop mein sthit) kiye gaye. Samvidhan swatantr Bharat ki neev (cornerstone) tha. Azaadi ke andolan ke kai neta Constituent Assembly ke members bhi the — isliye unhone apne sangharsh ke anubhav aur vichaar seedha samvidhan tak pahuncha diye. In values aur ideals mein kuchh yeh hain: sabki samanta (equality of all), sabke liye nyay (justice for all), svatantrata (freedom), bhaichara (fraternity), Bharat ki saanskritik virasat ka sanrakshan (preservation of India cultural heritage), aur yeh soch ki Samvidhan ko in values aur ideals ko haasil karne ka auzaar aur marg (tool and means) mana jaaye. Sangharsh ke anubhav aur seekh ne kai "kaise (how)" aur "kya (what)" wale sawaalon ke jawaab bhi diye — jaise chunav ka adhikaar, adhikaaron ka alag-alag hona, samvidhan badalne ki prakriya, aur kendra-rajya sarkaaron ka rishta (aage detail mein aayenge). 📷 Fig 10.4.1 — Workings of the Constituent Assembly — Assembly ka kaam karne ke drishya — jahan swatantrata sangharsh ke leaders samvidhan par baith kar vichaar kar rahe the.

text: LET US EXPLORE box ke anusaar hum kya dhoondhne jaate hain?
options: Apne kshetra ke log jo samvidhan banane mein hisse le sakte the
ans: Apne kshetra ke log jo samvidhan banane mein hisse le sakte the
explanation: Activity mein hum apne region ke un logon ke naam dhoondhte hain jo samvidhan banane mein hissa le sakte the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Book hint deti hai: school ya local library ki kitaabein, teacher-maa-baap aur mohalle ke buzurg — aur sansad ki website explore karo. Yeh activity dikhati hai ki samvidhan banana sirf kuch famous netaon ka kaam nahi tha — poore India ke log is se jude the. Har region ke representatives the Assembly mein!

text: Samvidhan banane wali Assembly kis naam se jaani jaati hai?
ans: Constituent Assembly (Samvidhan Sabha)
explanation: Samvidhan Constituent Assembly ne banaya — isliye ise Samvidhan Sabha kehte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Naam ka matlab hi "banana wali Assembly" hai — Constituent = banane wali. Aaj ki Lok Sabha se different: Constituent Assembly sirf samvidhan banane ke liye bani thi. Crossword ka ek clue isi par hai: "The group of people who wrote the Indian Constitution" — jawab Constituent Assembly!

text: Bhartiya Samvidhan par kitne bade prabhav rahe (is page ke anusaar)?
options: Teen — freedom movement, civilisational heritage aur doosre deshon ke samvidhan
ans: Teen — freedom movement, civilisational heritage aur doosre deshon ke samvidhan
explanation: Teen prabhav: (1) swatantrata andolan ke anubhav-vichaar-ideals, (2) Bharat ki sabhyata-virasa aur sanskriti, (3) doosre deshon ke samvidhanon se upyogi seekh. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh teen headings chapter ke aage ke hisse hain! Freedom movement se values aayi, civilisational heritage se concepts (jaise vasudhaiva kutumbakam), aur doosre deshon se structures (jaise France se liberty-equality-fraternity, Ireland se DPSP). Teeno ko alag-alag yaad karna exam ke liye zaroori hai.

text: Swatantrata andolan ke kaunse values samvidhan mein enshrine kiye gaye?
options: Sabki samanta, sabke liye nyay, svatantrata, bhaichara aur saanskritik virasat ka sanrakshan
ans: Sabki samanta, sabke liye nyay, svatantrata, bhaichara aur saanskritik virasat ka sanrakshan
explanation: Values: equality of all, justice for all, freedom, fraternity, Bharat ki saanskritik virasat ka sanrakshan — aur samvidhan ko inko haasil karne ka auzaar banana. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek aur idea bhi book mein hai: Constitution ko tool aur means ke roop mein dekhna — yani samvidhan values tak pahunchne ka rasta hai, sirf kanoon ki kitab nahi. Freedom struggle mein jo sapne dekhe gaye the (samanta, nyay), unhe samvidhan ka roop dena tha — aur azaadi ke baad values tak pahunchne ka rasta bhi yahi tha.

text: Swatantrata sangharsh ke neta samvidhan banane mein itne involved kyun the?
options: Kai freedom movement ke neta Constituent Assembly ke members the — anubhav aur vichaar seedha samvidhan tak pahuncha
ans: Kai freedom movement ke neta Constituent Assembly ke members the — anubhav aur vichaar seedha samvidhan tak pahuncha
explanation: Kai freedom movement ke neta khud Constituent Assembly ke members the — isliye unke anubhav aur vichaar seedhe samvidhan mein aa gaye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh bahut logical connection hai: jo log desh ki azaadi ke liye lade the, unhi ne azaad desh ke rules likhe. Isi liye samvidhan mein freedom struggle ki values (samanta, nyay) naturally jaa basi. Assembly ke members 299 the jinmein freedom fighters, jurists, social workers sab the — diverse talent ka mix!

text: Samvidhan ko kis cheez ke roop mein dekha gaya hai (freedom movement ke sandarbh mein)?
options: Values aur ideals haasil karne ka auzaar aur marg (tool and means)
ans: Values aur ideals haasil karne ka auzaar aur marg (tool and means)
explanation: Book kehti hai: samvidhan ko in values aur ideals ko haasil karne ka tool aur means ke roop mein dekha jaata raha hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Soch ka transformation: pehle values ke liye ladaai (struggle), phir usi values ko samvidhan ke through laagu karna (means). Jaise nyay ke liye courts ka system bana, samanta ke liye Article 14 bana. Values + samvidhan = ideal desh — yehi model hai.

text: Sangharsh ke anubhav ne kaunsa type ke sawaalon ke jawaab diye?
options: Kaise (how) aur kya (what) wale sawaalon ke
ans: Kaise (how) aur kya (what) wale sawaalon ke
explanation: Anubhav aur seekh ne "how" aur "what" wale sawaalon ke jawaab diye — misal: har nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar kaise mile, executive-legislature-judiciary ke adhikaar alag kaise rakhe jayein, samvidhan mein badlav (amend) ka kya process ho, kendra aur rajya sarkaaron ka rishta kya ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh 4-5 sawaal agle page par detail mein aate hain. Note karo ki yeh sab practical sawaal hain — values ko zameen par utaarna in ka kaam hai. Freedom struggle ne sochna sikhaya tha, ab usi soch ka institutional version banna tha.

text: CHITRA 10.4.1 mein kya dikhaya gaya hai?
options: Workings of the Constituent Assembly — Assembly ka kaam
ans: Workings of the Constituent Assembly — Assembly ka kaam
explanation: Fig 10.4.1 mein Constituent Assembly ke kaam karne ke drishya (Workings) hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Is chapter mein Constituent Assembly ki 3 tasveerein hain — Fig 10.4.1, 10.4.2 aur 10.4.3 — teeno Assembly ke kaam dikhati hain. Assembly ke members deskon par baith kar debate karte the, documents padhte the. 1946 ke zamane ki yeh tasveerein humein samvidhan ki banne ki prakriya live dikhati hain!

text: Freedom movement ke prabhav ko book ne kaise describe kiya?
ans: Ek mahatvapurna (significant) prabhav
explanation: Book kehti hai: freedom movement ke anubhav, vichaar aur ideals ka samvidhan par mahatvapurna (significant) prabhav raha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Significant = mahatvapurna. Simple logic: samvidhan banane wale log khud movement ke the! Isliye bhaichara jaisa concept (jo movement mein mila) samvidhan ke Preamble mein FRATERNITY ban gaya. Aage dekhoge — Preamble ke almost har shabd freedom struggle ki values se milta hai.

text: Bhartiya Samvidhan ko swatantr Bharat ki kya kaha gaya hai?
options: Neev / cornerstone (mooj ki haddi jaisi neev)
ans: Neev / cornerstone (mooj ki haddi jaisi neev)
explanation: Samvidhan swatantr Bharat ki neev (cornerstone) tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Cornerstone = building ki sabse badi patthar jis par poora dhancha khada hota hai. Azaad des ka poora system isi par khada hai — sarkar, kanoon, adhikaar, sab. Isi liye Constitution ki hifazat itni seriously li jaati hai — helium case se lekar Rashtrapati ki oath tak!

text: Samvidhan ki prakriya mein logon ke anubhav ka kya role tha?
options: Assembly ke members apne sangharsh ke anubhav aur vichaar samvidhan tak laaye
Sirf judges ka anubhav count hota hai
Sirf British ka anubhav count hua
ans: Assembly ke members apne sangharsh ke anubhav aur vichaar samvidhan tak laaye
explanation: Assembly ke members — jinmein kai freedom fighters the — apne anubhav aur vichaar Assembly mein laaye, jahan debate hui aur woh samvidhan ka hissa bane. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh "experience se law tak" ka safar hai. Jaise koi khel khelna wala coach ban jaata hai aur rules better samajhta hai — waise hi sangharsh ke anubhav ne samvidhan ke designers ko bataya ki kaunse rules kaam karte hain, kaunse nahi. Practical wisdom + ideals = Bhartiya Samvidhan.

ruleTitle: PAGE 7 — How aur What ke Sawaal — Assembly ki Tasveerein (PDF p.8)
conceptText: 📷 Fig 10.4.2 — Workings of the Constituent Assembly — Assembly ke kaam karne ka ek aur drishya. 📷 Fig 10.4.3 — Workings of the Constituent Assembly — members debates aur discussions mein ...aur isi tarah aage! Freedom struggle ke anubhav ne jin "how" aur "what" sawaalon ke jawaab diye, unmein yeh shamil the: • Hum kaise sure karein ki har vyast (adult) nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar mile? • Hum kaise ensure karein ki executive, legislature aur judiciary ke adhikaar (powers) alag-alag rakhe jaayein? • Hum kaise guarantee karein ki har vyakti ke fundamental rights (moolbhoot adhikaar) ka samman ho? • Agar hum samvidhan mein badlav (amend) karna chahein toh kya process hona chahiye? • Kendra aur Rajya sarkaaron ke beech rishta kya hona chahiye? — aur isi tarah aage. Chapter kehta hai ki humein is baare mein glimpses (jhalkiyan) mileingi ki yeh sab samvidhan mein kaise structure kiya gaya hai — is chapter mein aage.

text: CHITRA 10.4.2 aur 10.4.3 mein kya dikhaya gaya hai?
options: Workings of the Constituent Assembly — Assembly ka kaam karne ke drishya
ans: Workings of the Constituent Assembly — Assembly ka kaam karne ke drishya
explanation: Fig 10.4.2 aur 10.4.3 — dono mein Constituent Assembly ke kaam karne ke drishya (Workings) hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Constituent Assembly ki 3 tasveerein is chapter mein hain — Fig 10.4.1, 10.4.2, 10.4.3 — sab Assembly ke kaam dikhati hain. In tasveeron se humein 1946-1949 ke woh din yaad aate hain jab 299 members lagbhag 3 saal tak desh ke rules par baith kar soch rahe the!

text: Freedom struggle ke jawaabne kaunsa sawaal "how" type ka hai?
options: Har vyast nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar KAISE mile — yeh "how" sawaal hai
ans: Har vyast nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar KAISE mile — yeh "how" sawaal hai
explanation: "How" = kaise. Misaal: har adult nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar kaise milega — yeh practical design ka sawaal hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: "What" sawaal "kya" poochta hai (jaise sarkar kaisi ho), "how" sawaal "kaise" poochta hai (vote kaise sabko milega). Constitution dono type ke sawaalon ke jawaab deta hai — values bhi (what) aur process bhi (how). Isliye woh itna detailed document hai!

text: Assembly ne kis baat ko sure karna tha voting ke bare mein?
options: Har vyast (adult) nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar mile — universal adult franchise
Sirf sheher ke log vote karein
ans: Har vyast (adult) nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar mile — universal adult franchise
explanation: Sawaal tha: har vyast nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar kaise sure ho — yani sabko, kisi bhi tarah ke chunav-vichhod (restriction) ke bina. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Iska jawab universal adult franchise bana — har 18+ nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar. Aage chapter ke questions mein book kahti hai: India woh des hai jismein shuruaat se hi universal adult franchise diya gaya. 1950 mein jab duniya ke kai deson mein aurat ya gareeb log vote nahi kar sakte the, Bharat ne sabko vote diya!

text: Executive, legislature aur judiciary ke adhikaar ka kya hona chahiye tha (Assembly ke sawaal ke anusaar)?
ans: Alag-alag rakhe jaayein (kept separate)
explanation: Sawaal: teeno organs ke adhikaar alag-alag (separate) kaise rakhe jaayein — jise separation of powers kehte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Separation of powers ka matlab: kanoon banane wala, chalane wala aur faisla karne wala — teeno alag. Yeh Grade 6 ka revisited concept hai. Isse koi ek organ itna powerful nahi ho paata ki woh tanaha desh chala de. Constitution ne teeno ke roles clearly define kiye.

text: Assembly ne kis cheez ki guarantee karni thi har vyakti ke liye?
options: Har vyakti ke fundamental rights ka samman (respect) ho
ans: Har vyakti ke fundamental rights ka samman (respect) ho
explanation: Sawaal: har vyakti ke fundamental rights (moolbhoot adhikaaron) ka samman kaise guaranteed ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fundamental Rights woh adhikaar hain jo har vyakti ko Constitution deta hai — jaise samanta, svatantrata, shiksha. Guarantee ka matlab: inhe court se enforce kiya ja sakta hai. Isi liye Fundamental Rights "promises that must be kept" kehlate hain — aage p.13 par detail!

text: Samvidhan mein badlav (amend) karne ka sawaal kis baare mein tha?
options: Badlav karne ka kya process hona chahiye
Badlav sirf raja kar sakta hai
ans: Badlav karne ka kya process hona chahiye
explanation: Sawaal: agar samvidhan mein badlav (amend) karna ho toh kya process hona chahiye — yani badlav ka tareeka kya ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Badlav = amendment. Constitution ke makers jaante the ki samay ke saath naye kanoon zaroor honge — isliye amendment ka process hi bana diya. Aage p.15 par dekhoge: amendments Parliament mein rigorously debate hone ke baad hi maane jaate hain. Yeh Constitution ko living document banata hai.

text: Kendra aur Rajya sarkaaron ka rishta kis sandarbh mein aaya?
options: Kendra-Rajya sarkaaron ke beech ka rishta (relationship) kya hona chahiye
ans: Kendra-Rajya sarkaaron ke beech ka rishta (relationship) kya hona chahiye
explanation: Sawaal: kendra aur rajya sarkaaron ke beech rishta kya hona chahiye — yani power ka bantwara kaisa ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: India jaise bade desh mein decisions kuch kendra ko, kuch rajya ko, aur kuch local level (Panchayati Raj) ko — yeh teen-tier system Grade 6 mein bhi aaya tha. Constitution ne tay kiya kaunse functions central government ke liye reserve hain aur kaunse state ko diye gaye. Isko federal structure kehte hain.

text: Chapter ke mutabik in sab sawaalon ke structure ki jhalak kahan milegi?
options: Isi chapter mein aage (later in this chapter)
ans: Isi chapter mein aage (later in this chapter)
explanation: Book kehti hai: humein glimpses (jhalkiyan) mileingi ki yeh sab samvidhan mein kaise structured hua hai — is chapter mein aage. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh ek transition line hai — jo sawaal yahan uthe hain (vote, separation, rights, amendment, kendra-rajya), unke jawab chapter ke aage ke sections mein aate hain: Key Features (p.12-14) aur Living Document (p.15). Reading strategy: sawaal yaad rakho, jawab aane par mila lo!

text: Assembly mein debates mein kaun hissa lete the?
options: Constituent Assembly ke members — freedom fighters, jurists, social workers sab
ans: Constituent Assembly ke members — freedom fighters, jurists, social workers sab
explanation: Debates mein Constituent Assembly ke members hissa lete the — jo diverse background se aaye the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 299 members mein se kai freedom movement ke neta the, kuch jurists, kuch social workers. Fig 10.4.2 aur 10.4.3 unhi debates ke drishya hain — jahan har shabd par rai di gayi. Diverse backgrounds ki wajah se har paksha se aawaaz aayi — yahi Assembly ki sabse badi taakat thi.

text: "Fundamental" shabd ka kya matlab hai (fundamental rights ke sandarbh mein)?
options: Moolbhoot — sabse aadharbhoot, hataye nahi ja sakte
ans: Moolbhoot — sabse aadharbhoot, hataye nahi ja sakte
explanation: Fundamental = moolbhoot — aise adhikaar jo har vyakti ke liye aadharbhoot hote hain aur jinka samman hona guaranteed hona chahiye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Moolbhoot adhikaar hatakar koi bhi vyakti ya sarkar is adhikaar ko nahi maar sakta. Fundamental Rights ko court enforce kar sakta hai — isi liye yeh promises that must be kept hain. Sabse pehle is chapter mein yeh concept aata hai "har vyakti ke fundamental rights ka samman" ke sawaal ke roop mein.

ruleTitle: PAGE 8 — Sabhyata-Virasa aur Duniya ke Samvidhan — Seekhein (PDF p.8-9)
conceptText: 📌 India Civilisational Heritage and History — Sabhyata-Virasa 📌 LET US REMEMBER — Grade 6 se Grade 6 ke "Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One" (anekta mein ekta) waale chapter mein humne padha tha ki Bharat ek desh kaise hai aur jo ekta (unity) vividhata ko aalingan karti hai woh kaisi hai. Bharat ke ek desh hone ka yeh idea samvidhan mein embedded (samaa hua) hai. Hamari sanskriti mein kuch moolbhoot siddhant embedded hain: • yeh svaikaar (acceptance) ki log alag-alag drishtikon (points of view) rakh sakte hain; • Prakriti pavitra (Nature as sacred) hai; • gyaan ki khoj (pursuit of learning and knowledge); • nari ka samman (respect for women); • vasudhaiva kutumbakam ("the world is one family" — duniya ek parivaar hai) ka concept; • sarve bhavantu sukhinah (sab jeevon ke kalyan ke liye prarthana — an invocation for the well-being of all creatures). Yeh sab siddhant hamare samvidhan mein jagah paate hain — haan, thoda alag roop mein vyakt (expressed) ho sakte hain! 📌 LET US REMEMBER — Governance systems Pehle humne Bharat mein try kiye gaye kai tarah ke shasan systems ka varnan kiya tha — janapadas, sanghas (assemblies), shaasak aur unki parishadein (rulers and their councils), Kautilya ka saptanga concept, rajadharma aadi se. Kul milkar, shasan mein logon ke farz aur bhumika par bhaari zor (emphasis) raha hai. Isliye yeh natural tha ki samvidhan ke rachayita (Constitution makers) apni sabhyata-virasa ke in ideas ko samvidhan mein shaamil karte — misal ke taur par Fundamental Duties iska hissa hain! 📌 Learnings from Across the World — Duniya Bhar se Seekh Bhartiya parampara a no bhadrah kratavo yantu vishwatah — "Let noble thoughts come to me from every side" (mujhe har taraf se unnat vichaar aayein) — ke anusaar, samvidhan ke rachayitaon ne France, USA, UK, Ireland, Australia aur doosre lokatantrik vyavastha wale deshon ke samvidhanon ka adhyayan kiya — taaki unki upyogita hamare sandarbh (context) mein explore ki ja sake. Kuchh misaalein: • liberty, equality, fraternity ke ideals France ke samvidhan se adopt kiye gaye (jinhone unhe 1789 ki French Revolution se enshrine kiya tha); • Directive Principles of State Policy ka idea Irish Constitution se inspire hua; • American Constitution ne independent judiciary (swatantr nyaypaalika) ke concept ko shape karne mein madad ki. 📷 Fig 10.5 — Yeh Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen — jisne samanta, svatantrata aur nyay par focus kiya, 1789 ki French Revolution ke dauraan bana. Isne duniya ke kai hisson mein aise ideals ke phailaav mein madad ki; kai samvidhanon (French samvidhan samet) ne iske values aur principles adopt ya adapt kiye .

text: Grade 6 ke kis chapter se "India is one country" ka idea aaya hai?
options: Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One (anekta mein ekta)
ans: Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One (anekta mein ekta)
explanation: Grade 6 mein Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One chapter mein padha tha — aur Bharat ek desh hone ka yeh idea samvidhan mein embedded hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Many in the One = anekta mein ekta. Bharat ki diversity (bhaasha, dharm, khaana, kapde) ke bawajood hum ek desh hain — yehi underlying unity samvidhan ki bhi neev hai. Isi liye Constitution ek sangathan (Union) hai, alag-alag tukdon ka nahi. Ekta + vividhata = Bhartiya model!

text: Hamari sanskriti mein kaunsa moolbhoot siddhant embedded hai — "different points of view" wala?
options: Sabki ek hi rai honi chahiye
Yeh svaikaar ki log alag-alag drishtikon rakh sakte hain
ans: Yeh svaikaar ki log alag-alag drishtikon rakh sakte hain
explanation: Siddhant: acceptance ki log alag-alag points of view rakh sakte hain — alag rai ka sammann. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh pluralism (bahulvaad) ki purani Bharatiya soch hai. Constitution ne ise Freedom of Expression (vichaar-vyakt ki svatantrata) ke roop mein adopt kiya. Duniya mein aaj bhi "agree to disagree" ki quality rare hai — hamari sabhyata mein yeh hazaron saal purana siddhant hai!

text: Vasudhaiva kutumbakah ka kya matlab hai?
options: The world is one family — duniya ek parivaar hai
ans: The world is one family — duniya ek parivaar hai
explanation: Vasudhaiva kutumbakam = "the world is one family" — poori duniya ek parivaar hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh shabd Maha Upanishad se aata hai aur hamari parampara mein embedded hai. Constitution ke Preamble mein FRATERNITY (bhaichara) isi bhavana ka astitvik roop hai — sab nagrik ek parivaar ke sadasy jaise. Sarve bhavantu sukhinah ke saath yeh pair yaad rakho — dono sanskrit concepts Constitution tak pahunche!

text: Sarve bhavantu sukhinah ka kya arth hai?
options: Sab jeevon ke kalyan ke liye prarthana — invocation for well-being of all creatures
ans: Sab jeevon ke kalyan ke liye prarthana — invocation for well-being of all creatures
explanation: Sarve bhavantu sukhinah = sab jeevon (creatures) ke kalyan ke liye prarthana (invocation). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh prarthana kewal insaanon ke liye nahi — sab jeevon (creatures) ke liye hai. Isi bhavana ko Constitution ne Environment aur wildlife protection (Article 48-A, p.14 par aayega) jaise roop mein apnaya. Sanskriti ka Nature-respect + Constitution ka environmental duty — seedha connection!

text: Hamari sabhyata mein kis cheez par bhaari zor raha hai (shasan ke sandarbh mein)?
options: Shasan mein logon ke farz aur bhumika (duties and role of people) par bhaari zor
ans: Shasan mein logon ke farz aur bhumika (duties and role of people) par bhaari zor
explanation: Kul milakar shasan mein logon ke duties aur role par bhaari emphasis raha hai — aur isi liye Fundamental Duties samvidhan ka hissa bane! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Janapadas, sanghas, Kautilya ka saptanga, rajadharma — sab systems mein janata ki bhumika aur farz ka boo aur raha. Isi parampara se Constitution ke Fundamental Duties judte hain. Yeh connection exam mein achha question ban sakta hai: "Fundamental Duties kis parampara se aaye?"

text: Kautilya ka kaunsa concept book mein governance heritage ke roop mein aaya hai?
ans: Saptanga concept
explanation: Book Kautilya ka saptanga concept mention karti hai — janapadas, sanghas, rajadharma ke saath. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Saptanga = sato ang (saat bhaag) — raja ke shasan ke saat tatva. Kautilya (Chanakya) ne Arthashastra mein raja ke lye dharma aur structure bataya. Rajadharma = raja ke farz. Yeh sab ancient governance ke experiments the jahaaan se Constitution ne "duties" ki soch uthayi.

text: Samvidhan ke rachayitaon ne kaunse deshon ke samvidhan adhyayan kiye?
options: France, USA, UK, Ireland, Australia aur doosre lokatantrik desh
ans: France, USA, UK, Ireland, Australia aur doosre lokatantrik desh
explanation: Rachayitaon ne France, USA, UK, Ireland, Australia aur doosre democratic countries ke samvidhanon ka adhyayan kiya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh list yaad rakhna easy hai: F-U-U-I-A (France, USA, UK, Ireland, Australia). Lekin kaun se desh se kya liya — woh sabse important hai (France se ideals, Ireland se DPSP, America se independent judiciary). Sirf names ratta mat lagao — contributions yaad karo!

text: Liberty, equality aur fraternity ke ideals kis desh ke samvidhan se aaye?
ans: France (French Revolution 1789 se)
explanation: Liberty, equality, fraternity — France ke samvidhan se adopt kiye gaye, jinhone unhe 1789 ki French Revolution se liya tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: French Revolution (1789) ne yeh teen ideals duniya ko diye. Bharat ke Preamble mein LIBERTY, EQUALITY, FRATERNITY — teeno aate hain! Fig 10.5 mein Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen ka chitra hai — wohi revolution ka product. France ka contribution = values; Ireland ka = DPSP; America ka = judiciary. Teeno alag yaad rakho!

text: Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) ka idea kis samvidhan se inspire hua?
ans: Irish Constitution
explanation: DPSP ka idea Irish Constitution se inspire hua tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ireland ke samvidhan mein directive principles ka concept tha — goals jo sarkar try kare achieve karne ke liye (jaise sabki achhi standard of living). Bharat ne ise apnaya. Yaad rakhne ka trick: I-I — Ireland se Inspire hue DPSP. Aur Ireland ne khud ise Spain ke constitution se liya tha — ideas ki yeh chain duniya bhar mein chalti hai!

text: Independent judiciary (swatantr nyaypaalika) ke concept ko kis samvidhan ne shape karne mein madad ki?
ans: American
explanation: American Constitution ne independent judiciary ke concept ko shape karne mein madad ki. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Independent judiciary ka matlab: courts kisi sarkar ya neta ke dabav mein nahi chalti — woh akele Constitution ke hisaab se faisla karti hain. Isse hi courts fundamental rights ki raksha kar paate hain. USA ne apne Supreme Court ko strong banaya ka model diya — Bharat ne apnaya. Fig 10.5 ke baad yeh teesra videshi prabhav hai.

text: CHITRA 10.5 mein kaunsa historical document dikhaya gaya hai?
options: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen — 1789 French Revolution
ans: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen — 1789 French Revolution
explanation: Fig 10.5 — Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen — jo 1789 ki French Revolution ke samay bana tha aur samanta, svatantrata aur nyay par focus karta tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh declaration French Revolution se nikla aur duniya bhar ke samvidhanon ko prabhavit kiya — kai samvidhanon (French samvidhan samet) ne iske values adopt ya adapt kiye. "Adopt" = jaise tha waise le liya; "adapt" = apne hisaab se badal kar liya. Bharat ke Preamble ke ideals isi ideas ki parampara se hain!

text: A no bhadrah kratavo yantu vishwatah ka kya matlab hai?
options: Let noble thoughts come to me from every side — har taraf se unnat vichaar aayein
Sirf apne desh ke vichaar lo
ans: Let noble thoughts come to me from every side — har taraf se unnat vichaar aayein
explanation: A no bhadrah kratavo yantu vishwatah = "Let noble thoughts come to me from every side" — mujhe har taraf se unnat (noble) vichaar aayein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh sanskrit shlok (Rigveda se) samvidhan ke makers ki approach ka perfect summary hai: doosron ke samvidhan dekhe, achha liya, galat chhoda. Yeh openness hi Bhartiya soch ka nishaan hai — isliye France se ideals, Ireland se DPSP, America se judiciary — sab kuch apne sandarbh ke hisaab se liya gaya. Noble thoughts from every side — literatly!

ruleTitle: PAGE 9 — Samvidhan ke Chitra — Bhartiya Itihaas ke Drishya, Bhag 1 (PDF p.10)
conceptText: Samvidhan ke pehle page se lekar aakhri page tak — har page par Bhartiya itihaas ke drishya (scenes) banaye gaye hain. Yeh chitra samvidhan ki sabhyata-virasa ko dikhaate hain — puraane gurukula se lekar itihaas ke mahattvapurna pal tak. Dekho inmein se pehle chaar: 📷 Fig 10.6 — Ek praacheen gurukula ka drishya (A scene from an ancient gurukula) — jahan shiksha guru ke paas di gayi. 📷 Fig 10.7 — Ramayana ka ek drishya — Rama ka Lanka vijay aur Sita ki prapti (Rama conquest of Lanka and recovery of Sita) . 📷 Fig 10.8 — Mahabharata ka ek drishya — Krishna dwara Arjuna ko Gita ka upadesh (Krishna propounding the Gita to Arjuna) . 📷 Fig 10.9 — Orissan murtikala (sculptures) ka ek drishya — Odisha ki praacheen shilpkala. 📷 Samvidhan ka ek chitrit (illustrated) page — poore page par dekho kaise kala aur lekhan (text) saath-saath hain — har illustration Bhartiya itihaas ke ek pahalu ko dikhata hai.

text: CHITRA 10.6 mein kaunsa drishya hai?
ans: Ek praacheen gurukula (ancient gurukula)
explanation: Fig 10.6 — ek praacheen gurukula ka drishya — praacheen Bharat ka shiksha system jahan shishya guru ke paas reh kar padhte the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Gurukula system mein shiksha ghar jaisi jagah par hoti thi — guru-shishya parampara. Samvidhan ke pages par yeh drishya isliye hai kyunki gyaan ki khoj (pursuit of learning and knowledge) hamari sanskriti ka moolbhoot siddhant hai (p.8-9 par padha tha). Art aur values ka seedha connection!

text: CHITRA 10.7 mein Ramayana ka kaunsa drishya hai?

explanation: Fig 10.7 — Rama ka Lanka vijay (conquest of Lanka) aur Sita ki wapsi (recovery of Sita) ka drishya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ramayana ka yeh sabse mahatvapurna pal — Ravana ko harakar Sita ki wapsi. Unhone Mohenjo-daro se lekar freedom movement tak ke drishya banaye. Samvidhan sirf kanoon ka document nahi — work of art bhi hai. Isliye ise Parliament mein itni hifazat se rakha gaya hai!

Yeh span dikhata hai ki samvidhan ke makers ne poore itihaas ko apnaya — kisi ek kaal ka nahi. explanation: Yeh chitra Bharat ki sabhyata-virasa ke prateek hain — jo Constitution ke liye ek key influence thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chapter ke teeno influences yaad karo: freedom movement, civilisational heritage, videshi samvidhan. explanation: Gurukula gyaan ki khoj (pursuit of learning and knowledge) ko symbolise karta hai — hamari sanskriti ka moolbhoot siddhant. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: p.8-9 par padha tha: pursuit of learning and knowledge hamari sanskriti mein embedded hai. Kalakar ke paas aur kaam nahi tha

explanation: Epics ke drishya dikhate hain ki hamari saanskritik virasat ka sanrakshan (preservation of cultural heritage) samvidhan ke art mein bhi jhalakta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Dhyan se samjho: samvidhan kisi ek dharm ka document nahi — woh secular hai (Preamble mein aayega). Ramayana-Mahabharata ke drishya us dharm ke nahi, hamari sabhyata aur itihaas ke roop mein hain — jo har Bhartiya ki virasat hai. Cultural heritage samvidhan ki values mein hai (preservation of India cultural heritage).

text: Samvidhan ke pages par chitra aur text ka rishta kaisa hai?

Chitra aur text saath-saath hain — dono ek poore art-document banate hain
Text pehle tha, chitra baad mein poster ki tarah chipkaye

ruleTitle: PAGE 10 — Samvidhan ke Chitra — Bhartiya Itihaas ke Drishya, Bhag 2 (PDF p.11)
conceptText: Agle chaar drishya — jo samvidhan ke pages ko aur bhi bhartiya banate hain: 📷 Fig 10.10 — Nataraja ka ek chitra (An image of Nataraja) — nritya karte hue Shiv ka prasiddh roop. 📷 Fig 10.11 — Mahabalipuram ke bas-relief ke drishya — Bhagiratha ki tapasya aur Ganga ka avataran (Bhagiratha penance and the descent of Ganga) . 📷 Fig 10.12 — Akbar ke saath ek drishya aur Mughal architecture — Mughal kaal ki kala aur shasan. 📷 Fig 10.13 — Nalanda ko darshane wala drishya — Bharat ki praacheen universities mein se ek (one of India ancient universities). 📷 Samvidhan ka doosra chitrit page — is page par bhi kala aur lekhan saath hain — chitra Bhartiya itihaas ke aur pahalu dikhate hain.

text: CHITRA 10.10 mein kaunsa prasiddh roop dikhaya gaya hai?
ans: Nataraja ka ek chitra (image)
explanation: Fig 10.10 — Nataraja ka chitra — Shiv ji ka nritya karte hue roop. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Nataraja ka roop Bharatiya kala mein sabse iconic hai — chaturbhuj Shiv, apni energy se brahmand ki rachna aur vinash karte hue. Yeh roop Bharatnatyam jaise nritya se bhi juda hai. Samvidhan ke pages par Nataraja ka hona dikhata hai ki kala aur sanskriti ke prateek bhi Constitution ke art mein jagah paaye!

Mahabalipuram ke Mandir aur deewarein is kala ke world-famous examples hain. Yeh bhi samvidhan ke art mein aaya — kala ki variety dikhate hue: gurukula se relief tak, epics se architecture tak!

text: CHITRA 10.12 mein kya dikhaya gaya hai?

explanation: Fig 10.12 — Akbar ke saath ek drishya aur Mughal architecture — Mughal kaal ki kala ka samman. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Akbar ka kaal Mughal architecture ka golden period maana jaata hai — Fatehpur Sikri jaise shehar. Samvidhan ke pages par Mughal kaal ka drishya isliye hai ki Bhartiya itihaas ke sabhi mahatvapurna daur (Hindu, Muslim, colonial se pehle sab) ko samman diya gaya — yeh inclusive approach hi samvidhan ka core hai (pluralism!).

text: CHITRA 10.13 mein kaunsa drishya hai?

explanation: Fig 10.13 — Nalanda ko darshane wala drishya — Bharat ki praacheen universities mein se ek. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Nalanda (Bihar mein) duniya ke sabse pehle residential universities mein se tha — students duniya bhar se aate the (China se Xuanzang tak!). Yeh Bharat ke gyaan-parampara (pursuit of learning) ka sabse bada pramaan hai. Fig 10.6 ka gurukula shuruaat tha, Nalanda uska culmination — samvidhan ke pages par dono hain!

explanation: Nalanda Bharat ki gyaan-parampara ka prateek hai — praacheen Bharat ki mahaa-vishwavidyalaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Gurukula (Fig 10.6) se Nalanda (Fig 10.13) tak — samvidhan ke art pages par learning ka poora safar hai. Yehi woh pursuit of learning and knowledge hai jo hamari sanskriti ka moolbhoot siddhant hai (p.8). Isi liye Nalanda ka drishya Constitution ke pages par hai — desh ki shiksha-parampara ka samman!

text: Samvidhan ke illustrations mein kaisa span nazar aata hai (Fig 10.6 se 10.13)?

Nalanda Buddhist parampara se, Akbar Mughal se, Nataraja-Mahabalipuram Hindu kala se — sab ek hi samvidhan mein. explanation: Samvidhan sirf legal document nahi, ek work of art bhi bana — har page par kala aur lekhan milkar ek sangam banate hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Book (p.15) explicit kehti hai: "The Indian Constitution is not just a legal document but also a work of art." Calligrapher ne haath se likha, Nandalal Bose ki team ne chitra banaye. Isi liye original Constitution ko helium case mein rakha gaya — kanoon bhi, kala bhi, itihaas bhi!

text: Mohenjo-daro se lekar freedom movement tak — yeh span kiska hai?
ans: Samvidhan ke illustrations ka

Yeh chapter ke Figs 10.6-10.13 mein dikhta hai. Ek document jo poore desh ki kahani apne pages par rakhta hai — duniya mein aisa example bahut kam!

Ek desh jismein utna diverse art hai, uska sabse important document sab ko reflect kare — yeh natural hai! Isi liye illustrations mein koi ek kshetra ya kaal ka dominance nahi hai.

ruleTitle: PAGE 11 — Key Features — Teen Organs aur Electoral System (PDF p.12)
conceptText: Samvidhan ki mukhya visheshtaayein jaanne se pehle, Grade 6 mein dekhe gaye kuchh concepts ko dohraate hain: 📌 LET US REMEMBER — Grade 6 se • Sarkar ke teen organs hain — legislature, executive aur judiciary — aur inke prabhavi kaam ke liye adhikaaron ka alag-alag hona (separation of powers) zaroori hai. • Legislature kanoon banati hai (makes the laws). • Kanoon ko executive laagu karta hai — jiski adhyakshata Pradhan Mantri karte hain. • Judiciary yeh sure karti hai ki saare kanoon samvidhan ke anusaar hon. Yeh yeh bhi tay karti hai ki kanoon toota hai ya nahi aur kya saza deni chahiye. • Hamare paas sarkar ka teen-tier system hai — central (kendra), state (rajya) aur local (staniye — Panchayati raj system). • Kuchh functions aur zimmedariyaan central government ke liye reserve hain, aur doosri state government ko di gayi hain. Samvidhan in points ko poori tarah (comprehensively) sambodhit karta hai. Yeh har organ ki roles, functions, responsibilities aur accountability measures ko spasht roop se define karta hai. Chunav system (electoral system) bhi ismein diya gaya hai — taaki des ke har yogy (eligible) nagrik ko vote karne ka mauka mile.

text: Sarkar ke teen organs kaunse hain?
ans: Legislature, executive aur judiciary
explanation: Teen organs: legislature (kanoon banane wali), executive (kanoon chalane wali) aur judiciary (faisla karne wali). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Triangle model yaad karo: banane wala (legislature), chalane wala (executive), faisla karne wala (judiciary). Grade 6 mein yeh padha tha — ab Grade 7 mein dekhenge ki Constitution in teeno ki roles kaise define karta hai. Yeh samvidhan ka sabse core structure hai!

text: Kanoon kaun banata hai?
ans: Legislature
explanation: Legislature kanoon banati hai (makes the laws). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Bharat mein legislature = Parliament (Lok Sabha + Rajya Sabha) aur state vidhayikayein.
