Kanoon banane ka process debate, discussion aur voting se hota hai. Executive kanoon banata nahi — woh use chalata hai; judiciary use interpret karti hai — teeno ka kaam alag!

text: Kanoon ko kaun laagu (implement) karta hai?
options: Executive — jiski adhyakshata PM karte hain
ans: Executive — jiski adhyakshata PM karte hain
explanation: Executive kanoon ko laagu karta hai — jiski adhyakshata (headed by) Pradhan Mantri karte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Executive ka matlab: sarkar ka wo hissa jo rozana kaam chalata hai — ministries, police administration, schemes. PM aur unki council of ministers iski adhyakshata karte hain (parliamentary system). Note karo: President head of state hai, par executive ka kaam PM ke niche chalta hai — yeh Bharat ka parliamentary model hai!

text: Judiciary ka kya kaam hai?
options: Yeh sure karna ki saare kanoon samvidhan ke anusaar hon — aur faisla karna ki kanoon toota hai ya nahi, kya saza ho
ans: Yeh sure karna ki saare kanoon samvidhan ke anusaar hon — aur faisla karna ki kanoon toota hai ya nahi, kya saza ho
explanation: Judiciary yeh sure karti hai ki saare kanoon samvidhan ke anusaar (in accordance with the Constitution) hon — aur yeh tay karti hai ki kanoon toota hai ya nahi, aur kya saza deni chahiye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Judiciary = samvidhan ki rakshak! Agar koi kanoon samvidhan ke khilaaf hai, toh use badalna ya radd (nullify) karna padta hai. Supreme Court Bharat ki sabse oonchi adalat hai — crossword clue: "The highest court in India that protects the Constitution." Teen organs mein judiciary ka kaam: check karna + faisla karna.

text: Adhikaaron ka alag-alag hona (separation of powers) kyun zaroori hai?
options: Taaki sab ke paas same kaam ho
Teeno organs ke effective kaam ke liye — taaki koi ek bahut powerful na ho jaye
ans: Teeno organs ke effective kaam ke liye — taaki koi ek bahut powerful na ho jaye
explanation: Grade 6 ka lesson: separation of powers teeno organs ke effective working ke liye zaroori hai — koi ek organ itna powerful nahi hota ki sab kuch kare. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Imaagine karo: agar kanoon banane wala, chalane wala aur faisla karne wala ek hi vyakti ho — toh woh raja jaisa ho jayega! Alag-alag karne se checks and balances banta hai (p.3 par padha tha). Samvidhan ne teeno ki roles clearly define karke yeh separation sure kiya hai.

text: Bharat mein sarkar ke kitne tiers (star) hain?
options: Teen — central, state aur local (Panchayati raj system)
ans: Teen — central, state aur local (Panchayati raj system)
explanation: Bharat mein teen-tier system hai: central (kendra), state (rajya) aur local (staniye — Panchayati raj). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Teen levels: Delhi (central), Rajya Bhawans (state), aur gaon-sheher ki panchayats/local bodies (local). Panchayati Raj Grade 6 mein bhi aaya tha — aur p.15 par dekhoge ki 1992 ke 73rd Amendment se Constitution mein juda. Kaam jitna chhota (local), utna local level par — local logon ko apne kaam ka power milta hai!

text: Kuchh functions central government ke liye reserve hain, doosre state ko — iska ek misaal kya soch sakte ho?
options: Raksha (defence) jaisa kaam central ka, jabki gaon ki sadak jaisa kaam state ka
ans: Raksha (defence) jaisa kaam central ka, jabki gaon ki sadak jaisa kaam state ka
explanation: Samvidhan mein kuchh functions central government ke liye reserve hain aur doosre state government ko — jaise rashtriya raksha kendra ka kaam hai, jabki staniye development ka kaam aksar rajya ka. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kaam ki sharing ka faisla samvidhan mein likha hai. Raksha, currency, foreign affairs jaise national kaam kendra ko; police, shiksha, kheti jaise kaam states ko; aur local kaam (paani, sadkein) panchayats ko. Yeh division hi federal system hai — na ekdum central, na ekdum alag-alag!

text: Samvidhan har organ ki kya cheezein spasht roop se define karta hai?
options: Roles, functions, responsibilities aur accountability measures
ans: Roles, functions, responsibilities aur accountability measures
explanation: Samvidhan har organ ki roles, functions, responsibilities aur accountability measures (jawabdehi ke intezam) spasht roop se define karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Accountability ka matlab: koi bhi organ apne kaam ke liye jawabdeh hai — kisi ko bhi puchha ja sakta hai ki tune kya kiya. Yeh definition hona hi samvidhan ki taakat hai — sab kuch likha hua hai, koi andhere mein nahi. Isi se koi organ apni had paar nahi kar sakta.

text: Chunav system (electoral system) samvidhan mein kyun diya gaya hai?
options: Taaki des ke har yogy (eligible) nagrik ko vote karne ka mauka mile
ans: Taaki des ke har yogy (eligible) nagrik ko vote karne ka mauka mile
explanation: Samvidhan mein electoral system isliye diya gaya ki des ke har yogy nagrik ko vote karne ka mauka (enabled to vote) mile. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh p.8 ke sawaal ka jawab hai — "har adult nagrik ko vote ka adhikaar kaise mile?" Samvidhan ne chunav ka poora system design kiya: kaun vote kar sakta hai, kaise, kab. Isi se universal adult franchise sure hua — har 18+ nagrik ka vote ka adhikaar. Election Commission isse chalata hai!

text: Samvidhan ke core aspects mein se kaunsa Grade 6 ke revision mein NAHI tha?
options: Executive PM ki adhyakshatta mein kanoon chalata hai
Judiciary samvidhan ke anusaar kanoon check karti hai
ans: Railway ka timetable
explanation: Railway wala point nahi tha! Grade 6 revision: teen organs, separation of powers, PM-headed executive, judiciary ka check karna, aur teen-tier system — central, state, local (Panchayati raj). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Revision box ka pattern samjho: jo Grade 6 mein pada tha, wahi concepts ab samvidhan ke context mein aayenge — aur doosre core aspects (Fundamental Rights, Duties, DPSP) agle pages par aate hain. Pichla gyaan + naya gyaan = poori picture!

ruleTitle: PAGE 12 — DPSP vs Fundamental Rights aur Begum Aizaz Rasul (PDF p.13)
conceptText: Samvidhan ke doosre core aspects hain: Fundamental Duties (moolbhoot farz), Fundamental Rights (moolbhoot adhikaar) aur Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP). Infographic (Fig 10.14, agla page) inmein se kuchh Fundamental Duties aur Rights ke examples deta hai (jo poore roop mein saari NCERT kitaabon ke shuruaat mein list kiye jaate hain). DPSP — jaise popularly unhe kaha jaata hai — us saamajik aur aarthik vision ka saar (essence) hain jo samvidhan ke rachayitaon ne Bharat ke liye rakha tha. Infographic mein diye gaye examples un principles ko dikhate hain jinse woh chahte the ki shasan follow kare. 📌 DO NOT MISS OUT — DPSP vs Fundamental Rights Directive Principles (DPSP) aise goals hain jo sarkar haasil karne ki koshish kare. Yeh us disha (direction) ko darshate hain jismein woh chahte the ki desh chal kar Bharat ko sab ke liye behtar banaye; misaal ke taur par, des mein har vyakti ki achhi standard of living honi chahiye. Par agar sarkar iske liye koshish na kare, toh koi judge ke paas ja kar iski shikayat nahi kar sakta. DPSP zyada tar guidelines (margdarshak) hain, sakht rules nahi. Fundamental Rights, doosri taraf, aise vaade hain jo nishchit roop se nibhaane hain (promises that must be kept). Agar koi aapko aapke hone ki wajah se (because of who you are) anuchit vyavhaar kare, toh aap sach mein court ja sakte ho aur judge madad kar sakta hai. Samvidhan likhene walon ne yeh system jaan-boojh kar (on purpose) banaya. Unhone chahte the kuchh adhikaar jo turant demand kiye ja sakein (Fundamental Rights) aur kuchh bade goals (Directive Principles) jo desh ke progress ke saath samay ke saath haasil hone chahiye. 📌 LET US EXPLORE — Begum Aizaz Rasul ka bayan Neeche diya gaya quote padho. Aapke vichaar mein woh samvidhan ke kis article ki taraf ishara kar rahi thi? Aapke vichaar mein unhone yeh kyun kaha ki auraton ki samanta Bharat ke liye koi naya concept nahi tha? Class mein discuss karo. Sir, the women of India are happy to step into their rightful heritage of complete equality with men in all spheres of life and activity. I say so because I am convinced that this is no new concept which has been postulated for the purposes of this Constitution, but is an ideal that has long been cherished by India, though social conditions for some time had tragically debased it in practice. This Constitution affirms that ideal and gives the solemn assurance that the rights of women in law will be wholly honoured in the Indian Republic. — — Begum Aizaz Rasul, 22 November 1949, Constituent Assembly ke debates ke dauraan

text: Samvidhan ke core aspects kaunse hain?
options: Fundamental Duties, Fundamental Rights aur Directive Principles of State Policy
ans: Fundamental Duties, Fundamental Rights aur Directive Principles of State Policy
explanation: Core aspects: Fundamental Duties + Fundamental Rights + Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh teeno milakar samvidhan ki asli taakat hain — Duties (nagrik ke farz), Rights (nagrik ke adhikaar), DPSP (sarkar ke goals). Fig 10.14 infographic inhi ko organise dikhata hai. Teeno ke roles alag hain — aur agla MCQ unka farak poochta hai!

text: DPSP ki prakriti (nature) kya hai?
options: Sakht rules jo court enforce kare
Zyada tar guidelines — goals jo sarkar try kare achieve karne ke liye
ans: Zyada tar guidelines — goals jo sarkar try kare achieve karne ke liye
explanation: DPSP zyada tar guidelines hain, sakht rules nahi — aise goals jo sarkar haasil karne ki koshish kare. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: DO NOT MISS OUT box ka core: DPSP = guidelines. Misaal: sabki achhi standard of living — yeh goal hai, par isse turant court mein demand nahi kar sakte. Sarkar ki koshish (effort) hi DPSP ka asli test hai. "Directive" shabd ka hi matlab hai marg-darshak (guiding)!

text: Agar sarkaar DPSP follow nahi karti, toh kya ho sakta hai?
options: Judge ke paas ja kar complaint kar sakte ho
Court mein DPSP enforce nahi karwa sakte — DPSP enforceable nahi hain
ans: Court mein DPSP enforce nahi karwa sakte — DPSP enforceable nahi hain
explanation: Book: agar sarkar DPSP follow karne ki koshish nahi karti, toh koi judge ke paas ja kar shikayat nahi kar sakta — DPSP court mein enforce nahi hote. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yehi DPSP aur Fundamental Rights ka sabse bada farak hai! DPSP = goals (court nahi sun sakta), FR = promises (court sun sakta hai). Exam ka classic: "DPSP enforceable hain?" — Nahi, woh guidelines hain. Par iska matlab yeh nahi ki DPSP bekaar hain — woh desh ki vision hain jo sarkar ko follow karni chahiye!

text: Fundamental Rights ki prakriti kya hai?
options: Vaade jo nishchit roop se nibhaane hain — promises that must be kept
ans: Vaade jo nishchit roop se nibhaane hain — promises that must be kept
explanation: Fundamental Rights promises that must be kept hain — aise vaade jo zaroor nibhae jaane hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Promises that must be kept — yeh phrase yaad rakho! Agar koi aapko aapke hone ki wajah se (caste, dharm, gender) unfairly treat kare, toh aap court ja sakte ho aur judge help kar sakta hai. FR enforceable hain — yani inki hifazat kanoon ke through hoti hai. Yeh court wala option hi FR ki taakat hai!

text: DPSP kya represent karte hain?
options: Samvidhan ke rachayitaon ka saamajik aur aarthik vision — jo unhone Bharat ke liye rakha tha
ans: Samvidhan ke rachayitaon ka saamajik aur aarthik vision — jo unhone Bharat ke liye rakha tha
explanation: DPSP us saamajik aur aarthik vision ka saar (essence) hain jo samvidhan ke rachayitaon (framers) ne Bharat ke liye rakha tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Vision ka matlab: bade sapne — jaise sabki achhi standard of living, sabko shiksha, sabko sehat. Rachayita jaante the ki yeh ek raat mein nahi honge — isliye unhe DPSP (goals) banaya, FR (turant adhikaar) nahi. Samvidhan mein realistic planning hai: kuch abhi (FR), kuch dheere-dheere (DPSP).

text: Kis article par Begum Aizaz Rasul ka quote lagta hai (LET US EXPLORE ka sawaal)?
ans: Right to Equality — Article 14
explanation: Discussion ka javab: Begum ji ki baat samanta (equality) ki thi — jo Right to Equality (Article 14) se judi hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Begum Aizaz Rasul ne 22 November 1949 ko women ki poori samanta ki baat ki thi — "complete equality with men in all spheres of life". Article 14 (Equality before law) aur Article 15 (caste-lig-language par discrimination nahi) isi ideal ko laagu karte hain. Class discussion activity hai — "aapke vichaar mein" — isliye apni rai banao!

text: Begum Aizaz Rasul ke anusaar women ki samanta Bharat ke liye nayi concept kyun NAHI thi?
options: Kyun ki woh American concept tha
Kyunki yeh ideal Bharat mein lambe samay se cherisha (dil mein rakha) raha hai — haa, social conditions ne kuch samay tak practice mein ise giraya tha
Kyunki women ko pasand nahi tha
Kyun ki book mein nahi likha tha
ans: Kyunki yeh ideal Bharat mein lambe samay se cherisha (dil mein rakha) raha hai — haa, social conditions ne kuch samay tak practice mein ise giraya tha
explanation: Begum ji ka kehna: yeh aisa ideal hai jo Bharat mein lambe samay se cherished (dil mein rakha) raha hai — haa, kuch samay ke liye social conditions ne ise practice mein tragically gira diya tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh statement samvidhan ki soch ka core hai: samanta koi videshi import nahi — yeh hamari apni sabhyata ka ideal hai. Begum ji (muslim woman member!) Assembly mein keh rahi thi ki Constitution us ideal ko punah affirm (maankar) confirm karta hai. Cultural roots + constitutional affirmation = powerful combination!

text: Begum Aizaz Rasul ne apna bayan kab diya?
options: 22 November 1949 — Constituent Assembly ke debates ke dauraan
ans: 22 November 1949 — Constituent Assembly ke debates ke dauraan
explanation: Bayan 22 November 1949 ko Constituent Assembly ke debates ke dauraan diya gaya — yani Constitution adopt hone se thoda pehle. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1949 ka November — Assembly apne aakhri dinoon mein thi (26 Nov 1949 ko adopt hua). Begum ji ek aurat member ki taraf se poore desh ki auraton ke liye bol rahi thi. 15 women members mein se ek ki awaaz — jo Constitution mein gender samanta ke liye ek historic bhashan ban gayi!

text: Samvidhan ke rachayitaon ne FR + DPSP ka system kyun jaan-boojh kar banaya?
options: Kyunki unhone chahte the kuch adhikaar turant demand ho sakein (FR) aur kuch bade goals samay ke saath aayein (DPSP)
ans: Kyunki unhone chahte the kuch adhikaar turant demand ho sakein (FR) aur kuch bade goals samay ke saath aayein (DPSP)
explanation: Book: rachayitaon ne yeh system jaan-boojh kar (on purpose) banaya — kuch rights jo turant demand kiye ja saken (Fundamental Rights), aur kuch bade goals jo samay ke saath haasil hone chahiye (Directive Principles) jaise desh progress karta. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh smart design hai! Ek taraf turant enforceable rights (jaise samanta, svatantrata — jo aaj bhi zaroori hain), doosri taraf long-term vision (jaise sabki achhi jeevan-shtaithiti — jo dheere-dheere aati hai). Emergency vs long journey — dono zaroori the. Isliye do alag categories banayi gayi!

text: Fundamental Rights aur Duties ki poori list kahan milti hai (book ke anusaar)?
options: Saari NCERT kitaabon ke shuruaat mein list kiye jaate hain
ans: Saari NCERT kitaabon ke shuruaat mein list kiye jaate hain
explanation: Book kehti hai: yeh list saari NCERT kitaabon ke shuruaat mein poore roop mein list kiye jaate hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Agar aapne apni kisi bhi NCERT kitaab ke pehle pages dekhe honge — Fundamental Rights aur Duties ki list wahin milti hai! Is chapter ka infographic (Fig 10.14) sirf examples deta hai (jaise Article 14, 21), poori list nahi. Agle page par woh infographic detail mein aata hai!

ruleTitle: PAGE 13 — Fig 10.14 Infographic — Articles aur Duties ki Detail (PDF p.14)
conceptText: Yeh infographic (Fig 10.14) dikhata hai ki samvidhan ke hisse kaise aayojit (organised) hain — Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy aur Fundamental Duties, examples ke saath: 📌 Fundamental Rights (kuchh examples) • Right to Equality — Article 14: Equality before law (kanoon ke saamne sab barabar). • Right to Freedom — Article 21: Protection of life and personal liberty (jeevan aur vyaktigat svatantrata ki suraksha). • Right against Exploitation (shoshan ke khilaaf adhikaar). • Article 21-A: Right to education (shiksha ka adhikaar). 📌 Directive Principles of State Policy (kuchh examples) • Article 41: Welfare Government (kalyaankaari sarkar). • Article 44: Uniform Civil Code (sam anushasanik civil code). • Article 38: Social, Political, and Economic Justice (saamajik, raajnitik aur aarthik nyay). • Article 48-A: Environment and Wildlife Protection (paryavaran aur vanyajeev suraksha). • Article 49: Protection of monuments, places, and objects of national importance (rashtriya mahatva ke smarak-sthalon ki suraksha). • Article 47: Nutrition, standard of living, and public health (poshan, jeevan-shtaithiti aur jan-sehat). 📌 Fundamental Duties (kuchh examples) • Samvidhan aur uske ideals aur institutions, Rashtriya Jhanda (National Flag) aur Rashtragaan (National Anthem) ka paalan aur samman karna; • Desh ki raksha karna aur jab bulaaya jaaye rashtriya seva dena; • Hamari mishrit (composite) sanskriti ki ameer virasat ka mulya dena aur sanrakshan karna; • Prakritik paryavaran — jungle, jheelon, nadiyon aur vanyajeev samet — ki suraksha aur sudhaar karna aur jeevon ke prati daya (compassion) rakhna; • vyaktigat aur saamuhik gatividhiyon ke sabhi kshetron mein utkrishtata (excellence) ki or pragati karna — taaki desh prayas aur upalabdhi ke oonchayi staron par lagataar badhta rahe; • Maa-baap ya sanrakshak hone par — apne bachche/ward (child ya ward) ko jo chhe se chaudah saal ke beech ho — shiksha ke avsar upalabdh karana.

text: Right to Equality kis article se juda hai?
ans: Article 14 — Equality before law
explanation: Right to Equality — Article 14: Equality before law (kanoon ke saamne sab barabar). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Article 14 ka simple matlab: kanoon sabke liye same hai — koi raja ka beta nahi, koi gareeb ka beta nahi. Yehi woh article hai jise Begum Aizaz Rasul ke quote se joda ja sakta hai (women ki samanta!). Article numbers ke saath rights yaad karna Class 7 se hi shuru ho jaata hai — 14 = Equality, yeh ratta maar lo!

text: Article 21 kis Right ke antargat aata hai?
options: Right to Freedom — Protection of life and personal liberty
ans: Right to Freedom — Protection of life and personal liberty
explanation: Article 21 — Right to Freedom ka hissa hai: Protection of life and personal liberty — jeevan aur vyaktigat svatantrata ki suraksha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Article 21 samvidhan ka sabse powerful article maana jaata hai — jeevan ka adhikaar! Isse kai aur adhikaar nikale gaye hain. Aur Article 21-A (Right to education) bhi isi se juda ek adhikaar hai — har bachhe ko shiksha ka adhikaar. Dono numbers saath yaad rakho: 21 (life/liberty) aur 21-A (education).

text: Right to Education kis article mein hai?
ans: Article 21-A
explanation: Article 21-A — Right to education (shiksha ka adhikaar). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Article 21-A ka matlab: 6 se 14 saal ke bachchon ko muft aur aavashyak shiksha milna chahiye — yeh ek Fundamental Right hai! Note: yeh Fundamental Duties ki list mein bhi aata hai — "maa-baap ya sanrakshak hone par apne bachche ko 6-14 saal ki umar mein shiksha ke avsar dena." Ek taraf bachche ka RIGHT, doosri taraf maa-baap ka DUTY — dono saath mein kaam karte hain!

text: Article 44 kis DPSP ko darshata hai?
ans: Uniform Civil Code
explanation: Article 44 — Uniform Civil Code (sabke liye same civil niyam — DPSP ka hissa). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Uniform Civil Code ka matlab: aise kanoon jo sabke liye same hon (abhi alag-alag samudayon ke apne personal kanoon hain). Yeh ek Directive Principle hai — yani goal, jo sarkar try kare achieve karne ke liye. Yeh enforceable nahi hai — dhyan se DPSP list mein aata hai, Fundamental Rights mein nahi!

text: Environment aur wildlife ki suraksha kis article mein DPSP ke roop mein hai?
ans: Article 48-A
explanation: Article 48-A — Environment and Wildlife Protection — paryavaran aur vanyajeev ki suraksha (DPSP). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 48-A ka connection: hamari sanskriti mein Nature pavitra (sacred) hai (p.8-9 par pada tha — sarve bhavantu sukhinah sab jeevon ke kalyan ki prarthana!). Article 48-A aur Fundamental Duty (d) — jungle, jheelon, nadiyon aur vanyajeev ki suraksha, jeevon ke prati daya — dono milkar Constitution mein Nature-respect ko laagu karte hain. Sanskriti + Constitution = environmental protection!

text: Article 47 kis DPSP ko darshata hai?
options: Nutrition, standard of living, aur public health
ans: Nutrition, standard of living, aur public health
explanation: Article 47 — Nutrition, standard of living, and public health (poshan, jeevan-shtaithiti aur jan-sehat) — DPSP. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Article 47 ka matlab: sarkar try kare ki sabko achha khaana, achhi zindagi aur achhi sehat mile. Yehi woh "good standard of living" wala goal hai jo p.13 ke DO NOT MISS OUT box mein misaal ke taur par aaya tha! Ek saath note: 41 (Welfare), 47 (Nutrition/sehat) — dono welfare-related DPSP hain.

text: Fundamental Duties ki list mein "a" kya hai?
options: Samvidhan aur uske ideals aur institutions, National Flag aur National Anthem ka paalan aur samman karna
ans: Samvidhan aur uske ideals aur institutions, National Flag aur National Anthem ka paalan aur samman karna
explanation: Duty (a): Samvidhan aur uske ideals aur institutions, National Flag aur National Anthem ka paalan aur samman (abide by and respect) karna. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh pehli duty hai — aur kaafi sensible bhi: jo samvidhan tumhe adhikaar deta hai, usi ka samman karna sabse pehla farz hai! Jhanda aur rashtragaan des ke prateek hain — inka samman karna har nagrik ka kaam hai. Chapter ke end mein questions mein bhi yahi theme aata hai (crossword clue: "The part of the Constitution that outlines the duties of citizens towards the country")!

text: Fundamental Duties mein mishrit (composite) sanskriti ke baare mein kya kaha gaya hai?
options: Hamari composite sanskriti ki ameer virasat ka mulya dena aur sanrakshan karna
Doosron ki sanskriti ki alochna karna
ans: Hamari composite sanskriti ki ameer virasat ka mulya dena aur sanrakshan karna
explanation: Duty (c): hamari composite (mishrit) sanskriti ki ameer (rich) virasat ka mulya dena aur sanrakshan (preserve) karna. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Composite = mishrit — jaise alag-alag rang milkar ek sundar design banate hain, waise hi Bharat ki sanskriti kai dhaaron se mili-banati hai (yehi pluralism hai!). Yeh duty p.8-9 wale civilisational heritage influence ka seedha result hai — jo sanskriti hamari neev rahi, uska samman karna farz banaya gaya!

text: Jungle, jheelon, nadiyon aur vanyajeev ki suraksha kis Fundamental Duty mein hai?
options: Duty (d) — prakritik paryavaran ki suraksha aur sudhaar, jeevon ke prati daya
ans: Duty (d) — prakritik paryavaran ki suraksha aur sudhaar, jeevon ke prati daya
explanation: Duty (d): prakritik paryavaran — jungle, jheelon, nadiyon aur vanyajeev samet — ki suraksha aur sudhaar karna, aur jeevon ke prati daya (compassion for living creatures) rakhna. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek hi duty mein do bade ideas: paryavaran ki suraksha + jeevon ke prati daya. "Compassion" — patli daya — ka matlab hai ki sirf kaano se nahi, dil se jeevon ka khayal rakhna. Yeh duty sarve bhavantu sukhinah (sab jeevon ka kalyan) wale sanskrit invokation se poori tarah milti hai — jo hamari virasa se samvidhan tak aaya!

text: Chhe se chaudah saal ke bachche ko shiksha ke avsar dena kis ka Fundamental Duty hai?
options: Maa-baap ya sanrakshak (parent ya guardian) ka
ans: Maa-baap ya sanrakshak (parent ya guardian) ka
explanation: Duty (f): agar koi maa-baap ya sanrakshak hai, toh apne bache/ward (6-14 saal) ke liye shiksha ke avsar (opportunities for education) dena uski duty hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh duty Article 21-A (Right to Education) ka doosra pehlu hai: bachche ka adhikaar hai shiksha paana, aur maa-baap ka farz hai use upalabdh karana. Rights aur Duties do sided sikka hain — ek ka adhikaar doosre ka farz banta hai. Chhe se chaudah (6-14) — yeh umar range yaad rakhna important hai!

text: DPSP ki list mein se kaunsa NAHI hai?
ans: Article 14: Equality before law
explanation: Article 14 — Fundamental Right hai (Right to Equality), DPSP nahi! DPSP list mein hain: Articles 41, 44, 38, 48-A, 49, 47. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Classification ka exam favourite! Fundamental Rights: 14 (Equality), 21 (Life/Liberty), 21-A (Education), plus Right against Exploitation. DPSP: 38, 41, 44, 47, 48-A, 49. Lists alag-alag yaad karo — confusion hatao! Ek trick: Rights ke articles chhote numbers (14, 21), DPSP ke bade (38, 41, 44, 47, 48-A, 49).

ruleTitle: PAGE 14 — Ek Living Document — Amendments aur Kala (PDF p.15)
conceptText: Hamare samvidhan ke rachayitaon ne yeh samajha tha ki samay ke saath naye kanoon aur rules ki zaroorat ubharke aayegi. Misaal ke taur par, "Part IV-A: Fundamental Duties" ko 1976 mein joda gaya tha. Par yeh yaad rakhna zaroori hai ki samvidhan mein koi bhi badlav — jise "amendment" (samvidhan sanshodhan) kehte hain — Parliament mein sakhti se debate (rigorously debated) hone ke baad hi swikaar kiya jaata hai. Kuchh badlavon ke liye vidhayikaon (legislative assemblies) mein bhi debate chahiye hoti hai. Kai baar aam janta se bhi rai (opinions) li jaati hai. Kuchh badlav jan andolanon (popular movements) se bhi shuru hote hain. 📌 LET US EXPLORE — Badlav ke 3 udaharan • Ek samay tha jab log apne gharon par rashtriya jhanda (national flag) uchhalne ki ijaazat nahi thi. Yeh 2004 mein badla — jab ek nagrik ne mehsoos kiya ki apne desh mein garv prakat karne ka yeh uska adhikaar hai aur court mein is rule ko challenge kiya. Supreme Court se sehmat hua aur kaha ki jhanda fehrana Freedom of Expression (vichaar-vyakt ki svatantrata) ke Fundamental Right ka hissa hai. Ab hum garv ke saath tricolour fehra sakte hain — bas itna dhyaan rakhna ki woh kabhi apmaanit na ho. • Humne Panchayati Raj System Grade 6 mein padha tha. Yeh asli samvidhan ka hissa nahi tha; yeh 1992 mein 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act ke saath usmein shaamil (integrated) kiya gaya. • Kya aap pichle das saal (past ten years) mein hue amendments ke baare mein pata laga sakte ho? Sarkar logon ke liye propose kiye gaye kanoonon ya rules mein badlav par feedback dene ke avsar bhi banati hai. (Agla page — Fig 10.15 — iska ek highlighted udaharan dikhata hai.) 📌 DO NOT MISS OUT — Samvidhan: Ek Kala-kriti (Work of Art) Bhartiya Samvidhan sirf ek kanooni document nahi, balki ek kala-kriti (work of art) bhi hai. Calligrapher Prem Behari Narain Raizada ne iska text haath se likha (wrote its text by hand), jabki Nandalal Bose aur unki team ne iske pages ko Bhartiya itihaas ke drishyon se bhara (illustrated) — Mohenjo-daro se lekar freedom movement tak (Figs 10.6 se 10.13 dekho!).

text: Samvidhan ko "living document" kyun kaha jaata hai?
options: Kyunki usmein samay ke saath badlav (amendments) kiye ja sakte hain — naye kanoon aur rules ki zaroorat utarne par
Kyunki woh sirf judges padhte hain
ans: Kyunki usmein samay ke saath badlav (amendments) kiye ja sakte hain — naye kanoon aur rules ki zaroorat utarne par
explanation: Rachayita samajhte the ki samay ke saath naye kanoon aur rules ki zaroorat ubharke aayegi — isliye badlav ka system banaya gaya. Yeh flexibility hi use "living" banati hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek living document badalta rehta hai — par vyavasthit tareeke se! Agar Constitution badal hi nahi sakta, toh woh patthar ki tarah thand ho jaata — samaj badlega, rules nahi. Bharat ka Constitution 1950 se aaj tak badlaa hai — 1950 mein 22 parts the, ab 25! Pehle "Before we move on" summary bhi kehti hai: "It is a living document that can be improved as per the country needs."

text: Part IV-A — Fundamental Duties — kab joda gaya?
explanation: Part IV-A: Fundamental Duties ko 1976 mein joda gaya tha — Constitution lagu hone ke 26 saal baad! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mazedar baat: p.8-9 par hamari governance parampara mein "logon ke duties par bhaari zor" pada tha — par Duties Constitution mein 1976 mein hi judin! 1976 mein 42nd Amendment hua tha (jisse Preamble mein bhi Socialist aur Secular juda — p.17 par aayega). Ek hi amendment (42nd) se dono changes aaye — yeh connection exam mein poocha ja sakta hai!

text: Samvidhan mein badlav (amendment) kaise hota hai?
options: Parliament mein sakhti se (rigorously) debate hone ke baad hi — kuchh ke liye vidhayikaon mein bhi debate, kabhi janta se bhi rai
Kisi ek neta ke kehne par
ans: Parliament mein sakhti se (rigorously) debate hone ke baad hi — kuchh ke liye vidhayikaon mein bhi debate, kabhi janta se bhi rai
explanation: Har amendment Parliament mein rigorously debate hone ke baad hi swikaar kiya jaata hai. Kuchh ke liye legislative assemblies mein bhi debate chahiye. Kai baar aam janta se bhi opinions li jaate hain. Kuchh badlav jan andolanon (popular movements) se bhi shuru hote hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Amendment easy nahi hai — isliye Constitution roz nahi badalta! Do-level debate (Parliament + state assemblies) ka matlab: desh bhar ki sehmati chahiye. Aur popular movements ka role bhi hai — janta bol sakti hai, unki awaaz Constitution tak pahunch sakti hai. Yeh democracy ka asli roop hai!

text: Ghar par rashtriya jhanda fehrane ka adhikaar kab mila aur kaise?
options: 2004 — ek nagrik ne court mein challenge kiya, Supreme Court ne Freedom of Expression ka hissa mana
ans: 2004 — ek nagrik ne court mein challenge kiya, Supreme Court ne Freedom of Expression ka hissa mana
explanation: 2004 mein — ek nagrik ne rule ko court mein challenge kiya, aur Supreme Court ne kaha ki jhanda fehrana Fundamental Right to Freedom of Expression ka hissa hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh ek perfect example hai ki Constitution jeeta hua kaise hai — court ke through naye matlab nikal kar (interpretation) adhikaar badhte hain. Citizen ne laga ki yeh mera adhikaar hona chahiye — court se puchha — aur faisla uske haath mein aaya. Par condition bhi hai: jhanda kabhi apmaanit na ho! Rights ke saath respect ki zimmedari bhi aati hai.

text: Supreme Court ke 2004 ke faisle ke anusaar jhanda fehrana kis Right ka hissa hai?
ans: Right to Freedom of Expression
explanation: Court ne kaha: jhanda fehrana Freedom of Expression (vichaar-vyakt ki svatantrata) ke Fundamental Right ka hissa hai — desh mein garv dikhana bhi ek expression hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Freedom of Expression ka matlab sirf bolna nahi — apni bhavnaayein har tareeke se dikhana bhi. Jhanda apne desh se pyaar ka expression hai. Isliye yeh adhikaar Article 19 (freedom of expression) ke andar aata hai. Kanooni vyavastha (judicial system) ne nagrik ke adhikaar ka vistar kiya — living document ka ek aur example!

text: Panchayati Raj System Constitution mein kab shaamil hua?
ans: 1992 — 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act se
explanation: Panchayati Raj asli samvidhan ka hissa nahi tha; yeh 1992 mein 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act ke saath Constitution mein shaamil (integrated) kiya gaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1992 ka 73rd Amendment ek bada change tha: gaon ki sarkar (Panchayats) ko Constitution ki guarantee mili — chunav, reservation, funds ke saath. Ab Constitution ka teen-tier system (central-state-local) poori tarah Constitution mein hai! Panchayati Raj Grade 6 mein bhi pada tha — Constitution mein aane ka route yeh raha: 1992, 73rd Amendment. Dono numbers saath yaad rakho!

text: Samvidhan ka text kisne haath se likha?
ans: Calligrapher Prem Behari Narain Raizada
explanation: Calligrapher Prem Behari Narain Raizada ne samvidhan ka text haath se (by hand) likha tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Calligraphy = sundar likhai ki kala. Raizada ji ne mahino lagakar poora samvidhan haath se likha — aaj ki tarah print nahi! Aur Nandalal Bose ki team ne chitra banaye. DO NOT MISS OUT box kehta hai: samvidhan sirf legal document nahi — ek work of art hai. Do kalakaron ki team — ek text ke liye, ek art ke liye!

text: Samvidhan ke chitra kisne banaye?
ans: Nandalal Bose aur unki team
explanation: Nandalal Bose aur unki team ne samvidhan ke pages ko Mohenjo-daro se lekar freedom movement tak ke drishyon se illustrate kiya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Nandalal Bose Shanti Niketan se judhe kalakar the. Figs 10.6-10.13 (gurukula, Ramayana, Mahabharata, Nataraja, Mahabalipuram, Akbar, Nalanda) — sab unki team ki kala hain! Text (Raizada) + art (Bose) = ek work of art jo kanoon bhi hai. Isi liye original Constitution Parliament mein itni hifazat se, helium case mein, rakha gaya hai!

text: Sarkar logon ko proposed kanoonon par feedback dene ka mauka kaise deti hai?
options: Opportunities bana kar — jaise websites aur platforms jahan log apni rai de sakte hain
ans: Opportunities bana kar — jaise websites aur platforms jahan log apni rai de sakte hain
explanation: Book: sarkar logon ke liye feedback dene ke opportunities banati hai — proposed laws ya rules ke badlav par log apni rai de sakte hain (Fig 10.15 iska udaharan). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh "by the people" ko zinda rakhne ka tareeka hai — chunav har 5 saal mein hota hai, par kanoon ke muddon par rai roz ho sakti hai! Public feedback ka system batata hai ki democracy sirf voting nahi — participation hai. Agle page par Fig 10.15 iska ek asli udaharan dikhata hai.

text: Amendments ke 3 udaharan (LET US EXPLORE) kaunse hain?
options: Jhanda 2004, Panchayati Raj 1992, aur pichle 10 saal ke amendments khojna
ans: Jhanda 2004, Panchayati Raj 1992, aur pichle 10 saal ke amendments khojna
explanation: Teen udaharan: (1) 2004 ka jhanda faisla — Supreme Court ne Freedom of Expression maana; (2) 1992 ka 73rd Amendment — Panchayati Raj ka Constitution mein aana; (3) khud pichle das saal ke amendments dhoondhna — yeh students ke liye activity hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tino examples alag-alag raste dikhaate hain jaise Constitution badla: court case se (jhanda), Amendment Act se (Panchayati Raj), aur research activity se (aap khud dhoondho!). Isi diversity se pata chalta hai ki Constitution kai tareeko se badal sakta hai — aur har raaste mein public participation hai.

text: Samvidhan ke amendments ke liye debate kahan-kahan hoti hai (book ke anusaar)?
options: Parliament mein — aur kuchh badlavon ke liye vidhayikaon (legislative assemblies) mein bhi
ans: Parliament mein — aur kuchh badlavon ke liye vidhayikaon (legislative assemblies) mein bhi
explanation: Amendments Parliament mein rigorously debate hone ke baad hi maane jaate hain — aur kuchh ke liye legislative assemblies mein bhi debate chahiye hoti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do-level debate ka system isliye hai ki Constitution desh ka sabse important document hai — usse badalne se pehle desh bhar ki soch leni chahiye! Parliament (kendra) + state assemblies (rajya) — dono ki sehmati. Kai baar janta se bhi rai li jaati hai, aur popular movements bhi badlav shuru kar sakte hain. Yeh sab checks and balances ka hi hissa hai!

ruleTitle: PAGE 15 — Preamble ki Orr — Feedback ka Udaharan (PDF p.16)
conceptText: 📷 Fig 10.15 — Sarkar dwara banaye gaye avsar ka udaharan jahan log proposed kanoonon ya rules ke badlav par apna feedback (rai) de sakte hain — yeh highlighted portion pichle page ke "government creates opportunities for feedback" wale point ko dikhata hai. Samvidhan ke core values hi policies aur decision-making ke liye margdarshak siddhant (guiding principles) hain, jinhe sarkar ka follow karna ummeed kiya jaata hai. Nagrikon se bhi ummeed ki jaati hai ki woh unhe apni poori kshamata (to the best of their ability) ke hisaab se aamaal karein. Yeh margdarshak moolya (guiding values) samvidhan bhar mein maujood hain — par inka saar (essence) Preamble mein likha hai. Toh aaiye, Preamble ka adhyayan karein — jo is chapter ka ek uchit ant (fitting end) hai!

text: CHITRA 10.15 mein kya dikhaya gaya hai?
options: Sarkar ka ek aisa avsar (opportunity) jahan log proposed kanoonon ya rules par feedback de sakte hain
ans: Sarkar ka ek aisa avsar (opportunity) jahan log proposed kanoonon ya rules par feedback de sakte hain
explanation: Fig 10.15 — sarkar dwara banaye gaye feedback avsar ka highlighted udaharan — jahan log proposed laws ya changes in rules par apni rai de sakte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh p.15 wale point ka visual proof hai: "The government also creates opportunities for people to provide feedback on proposed laws or changes in rules." Janta sirf chunav ke din hi nahi — kanoon banne ke samay bhi apni awaaz rakh sakti hai. Yeh participatory (sabhagiyata wali) democracy ka udaharan hai!

text: Samvidhan ke core values ka kya role hai?
options: Policies aur decision-making ke liye margdarshak siddhant — jinhe sarkar ka follow karna ummeed hai
ans: Policies aur decision-making ke liye margdarshak siddhant — jinhe sarkar ka follow karna ummeed hai
explanation: Core values policies aur decision-making ke guiding principles hain — jinhe sarkar ka follow karna ummeed kiya jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Guiding principles ka matlab: jaise compass disha dikhata hai, waise values sarkar ke decisions ko disha dete hain. Agar sarkar koi policy banaye (jaise naya kanoon), toh use samvidhan ke values se match hona chahiye. Values = sarkar ka benchmark!

text: Nagrikon se samvidhan ke values ke liye kya ummeed hai?
options: Ki woh unhe apni poori kshamata (best of their ability) ke hisaab se aamaal (practise) karein
Ki sirf sarkar par chhod dein
ans: Ki woh unhe apni poori kshamata (best of their ability) ke hisaab se aamaal (practise) karein
explanation: Nagrikon se ummeed hai ki woh guiding values ko apni poori kshamata ke hisaab se practise karein — yani values sirf sarkar ke liye nahi, sabke liye hain! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Samvidhan dono taraf se bolta hai: sarkar values follow kare, aur nagrik bhi. Misaal: samanta (equality) ki value — sarkar sabko barabar mauka de (Article 14-15), aur nagrik bhi doosron ke saath bhed-bhav na kare. Rights lena + values jeena = asli nagrik!

text: Guiding values samvidhan mein kahan-kahan hain?
options: Samvidhan bhar mein maujood hain — par inka essence Preamble mein likha hai
ans: Samvidhan bhar mein maujood hain — par inka essence Preamble mein likha hai
explanation: Yeh guiding values samvidhan bhar mein maujood (present across the Constitution) hain — par inka saar (essence) Preamble mein likha hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Paryaay roop se samjho: poore samvidhan mein values baanti hui hain (har article mein kuchh na kuchh), par Preamble unki shakah (summary) hai — ek page par poora juice! Isliye Preamble ko samvidhan ki aatma (soul) kehte hain. Agle page par iska poora breakdown aata hai!

text: Preamble ka kya matlab hai?
options: Samvidhan ki shuruaat ka bayan — jo values batata hai (the statement at the beginning)
ans: Samvidhan ki shuruaat ka bayan — jo values batata hai (the statement at the beginning)
explanation: Preamble samvidhan ke shuruaat ka bayan hai — jo hamein batata hai ki samvidhan kaun si values ko apnaata hai (tells us the values it upholds). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Pre + amble = pehle chalna. Preamble samvidhan ke pehle aata hai aur poori kitab ka nichod deta hai. Crossword clue: "The statement at the beginning of the Constitution that tells us the values it upholds" — jawab PREAMBLE! Agle page par Preamble ke har shabd ka matlab dikhaayega.

text: Chapter ke hisaab se Preamble ka study kaise describe kiya gaya hai?
options: Is chapter ka ek fitting end — ek uchit samaapan
ans: Is chapter ka ek fitting end — ek uchit samaapan
explanation: Book: Preamble ka adhyaan is chapter ka fitting end (uchit ant) hai — kyunki values ka saar yahin hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chapter ka structure samajho: pehle Constitution kya hai (definition), phir kaise bana (history), phir influences, phir features — aur ant mein values ka saar (Preamble). Climax mein woh cheez jo sabse important hai — ideals! Yehi fitting end hai: jaanne ke baad ki kaise bana, ab dekho ki KYA bana!

text: Sarkar ko proposed laws par janta ki rai kyun chahiye (pichle page se joda jaaye)?
options: Kyunki samvidhan ek living document hai — aur janta ki participation se hi democracy zinda rehti hai
ans: Kyunki samvidhan ek living document hai — aur janta ki participation se hi democracy zinda rehti hai
explanation: Janta ki rai democracy ko zinda rakhti hai — aur samvidhan ke badlav ka system bhi yahin se rai maangta hai (kai amendments mein public opinions li jaate hain). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: P.15 par pada tha: kai baar aam janta se bhi opinions li jaati hain, aur kuchh badlav popular movements se shuru hote hain. Fig 10.15 usi ka asli udaharan hai. Chunav 5 saal mein ek baar hota hai, par participation roz hota hai — yehi asli loktantra hai!

text: Agar sarkar koi aisi policy banaye jo samvidhan ke values ke khilaaf hai, toh kya ho sakta hai?
options: Court use samvidhan ke anusaar check kar sakta hai — kyunki values hi policies ki benchmark hain
ans: Court use samvidhan ke anusaar check kar sakta hai — kyunki values hi policies ki benchmark hain
explanation: Values hi policies ki benchmark hain — aur judiciary yeh check karti hai ki saare kanoon samvidhan ke anusaar hon (p.12 par pada tha). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh connection samajhna important hai: values (Preamble) → principles (articles) → policies (sarkar ke kaam). Agar koi policy is chain se bahar jaati hai, toh court use rok sakta hai. Isi liye Preamble sirf shabd nahi — poori vyavastha ka base hai!

text: Core values ka "essence" kis mein likha hai?
ans: Preamble mein
explanation: In guiding values ka saar (essence) Preamble mein likha hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Essence = saar, jaise phool se ittar nikaalna. Samvidhan lamba document hai — parts, schedules, articles. Par Preamble us sab ka nichod hai: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic — aur Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity. Agle page par in sab ka matlab aayega — sabse exam-heavy page!

text: Preamble kis cheez ka nichod (saar) hai?
options: Poore samvidhan ke margdarshak moolya (guiding values) ka — jo samvidhan bhar mein phaile hue hain
ans: Poore samvidhan ke margdarshak moolya (guiding values) ka — jo samvidhan bhar mein phaile hue hain
explanation: Preamble poore samvidhan mein maujood guiding values ka saar (essence) hai — jaise poori kitaab ka ek-page summary. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chapter ke anusaar yeh values samvidhan ke har hisse mein hain — kanoon banane ke rules mein, rights mein, duties mein — par unka nichod Preamble mein hai. Isi liye use samvidhan ki aatma (soul) kehte hain! Chhota document, bada matlab — aur exam mein Preamble ke har shabd ka alag sawaal banta hai!

ruleTitle: PAGE 16 — Preamble — Har Shabd ka Matlab, Bhag 1 (PDF p.17)
conceptText: 📷 Fig 10.16 — Preamble of the Indian Constitution — samvidhan ki shuruaat ka bayan, jismein poore samvidhan ke values ka nichod hai. Preamble ke har shabd ka arth samajho — yehi samvidhan ki aatma hai: • WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA — Samvidhan janta dwara unke pratinidhiyon (representatives) ke through banaya aur laagu kiya gaya hai — kisi raja ya bahar ki taakat (outside powers) dwara neeche nahi thopwaya gaya. • SOVEREIGN (Samarpit/Swatantr) — Janta ke paas antarik aur bahari maamlon par faisla karne ka sarvoch adhikaar (supreme right) hai. Koi bahari taakat (external power) Bharat ki sarkar ko aadesh nahi de sakti. • SOCIALIST (Samajvaadi) — Daulat samajik roop se paida hoti hai aur samaj dwara share ki jaani chahiye. Sarkar ko zameen aur udyog ke swamitva par niyantran karke saamajik-aarthik asamaataon ko kam karne ke liye kaam karna chahiye. • SECULAR (Panthnirpeksh) — Nagrikon ko koi bhi dharm aane ki poori svatantrata hai. Par koi aadhikarik (official) dharm nahi hai. Sarkar sab dharm-on ki aasthaon aur rituals ke saath samman ke saath barabari ka vyavhaar karti hai. • DEMOCRATIC (Loktantratmak) — Aisi sarkar jismein janta ko barabar rajnitik adhikaar hote hain, woh apne shaasak chunti hain aur unhe jimmedaar banati hain (accountable). Sarkar kuchh basic rules ke anusaar chalti hai. 📷 Preamble ka poora chitrit page — jaise mool (original) samvidhan mein hai — calligraphy aur chitron ke saath, ek kala-kriti ke roop mein.

text: Preamble ki shuruaat kaise hoti hai?
ans: WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA
explanation: Preamble WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA se shuru hota hai — kyunki samvidhan janta dwara unke representatives ke through banaya gaya hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh shabd sabse powerful hai: power raja se nahi, British se nahi — JANTA se aayi hai! Constituent Assembly ke members provincial assemblies ke through logon dwara chune gaye the (p.6 par pada tha). Isliye samvidhan janta ka apna document hai — aur janta hi use badal sakti hai. WE, THE PEOPLE = janadesh ka sabse bada bayan!

text: WE, THE PEOPLE ka matlab kya hai?
options: Samvidhan janta dwara banaya gaya — kisi raja ya bahar ki taakat se nahi
ans: Samvidhan janta dwara banaya gaya — kisi raja ya bahar ki taakat se nahi
explanation: Preamble ke anusaar samvidhan janta dwara unke pratinidhiyon ke through draw up aur enact kiya gaya — kisi raja ya outside powers dwara nahi diya gaya (handed down). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: History mein aksar constitution raja ne diye (jaise Japan) ya videshi taakat ne thop diye. Bharat ka rasta alag tha: apni janta ne apne chune hue members ke through apna samvidhan banaya. Isi liye Bharat ka samvidhan jan-jaat (popular) legitimacy hai — aur isi liye WE, THE PEOPLE sabse pehle shabd hai!

text: SOVEREIGN ka kya matlab hai (Preamble mein)?
options: Janta ke paas antarik aur bahari maamlon par faisla karne ka sarvoch adhikaar — koi bahari taakat Bharat ki sarkar ko aadesh nahi de sakti
ans: Janta ke paas antarik aur bahari maamlon par faisla karne ka sarvoch adhikaar — koi bahari taakat Bharat ki sarkar ko aadesh nahi de sakti
explanation: SOVEREIGN = janta ka supreme right — internal aur external dono maamlon par faisla karne ka adhikaar. Koi external power sarkar ko dictate nahi kar sakti. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sovereignty ka arth: poora khud-mukhtar hona. 1947 se pehle British taakat Bharat ke maamle decide karti thi — azaadi ke baad yeh power janta ko lauta. Aaj koi videshi desh Bharat ko keh nahi sakta ki kaisa kanoon banao. Isliye Preamble mein SOVEREIGN pehla value hai — azaadi ka saboot!

text: SOCIALIST ka kya matlab hai (Preamble ke anusaar)?
options: Daulat samaj mein paida hoti hai aur samaj mein hi share honi chahiye — sarkar zameen-udyog ka niyantran karke asamaataan ko kam kare
ans: Daulat samaj mein paida hoti hai aur samaj mein hi share honi chahiye — sarkar zameen-udyog ka niyantran karke asamaataan ko kam kare
explanation: SOCIALIST = daulat samajik roop se paida hoti hai, isliye samaj dwara share honi chahiye. Sarkar ko zameen aur udyog (industry) ke swamitva par niyantran karke saamajik-aarthik asamaataon ko kam karna chahiye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Simple logic: koi vyakti akela daulat nahi bana sakta — majdoor, kisaan, grahak sab ka haath hota hai. Isliye daulat ka fayda sabko milna chahiye. Samvidhan mein yeh idea Directive Principles (Article 38 — Social and Economic Justice) ke through aage gaya. NOTE: Socialist shabd 1976 mein 42nd Amendment se juda tha — agle MCQs mein aur detail!

text: SECULAR state ka kya matlab hai?
options: Sabko ek dharm mein aana padta hai
Nagrikon ko koi bhi dharm aane ki poori svatantrata — par koi official dharm nahi; sarkar sab dharmon ke saath barabar samman
ans: Nagrikon ko koi bhi dharm aane ki poori svatantrata — par koi official dharm nahi; sarkar sab dharmon ke saath barabar samman
explanation: SECULAR = nagrikon ko koi bhi dharm follow karne ki poori svatantrata hai, par koi official (sarkari) dharm nahi. Sarkar sab religious beliefs aur practices ke saath equal respect ke saath treat karti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Secularism ka core: sarkar dharm ke maamlon mein neutral hai — na kisi dharm ko badhawa, na kisi ko rok. Har nagrik apna dharm azaadi se maan sakta hai. P.18 ke LET US EXPLORE mein iska daily-life example bhi aayega: "A person does not have to take permission from the State to practice the rituals of their religion." Aur yeh shabd bhi 1976 ke 42nd Amendment se juda!

text: DEMOCRATIC ka kya matlab hai (Preamble mein)?
options: Aisi sarkar jisme janta ko barabar rajnitik adhikaar — woh apne shaasak chunti hain aur unhe jimmedaar banati hain
ans: Aisi sarkar jisme janta ko barabar rajnitik adhikaar — woh apne shaasak chunti hain aur unhe jimmedaar banati hain
explanation: DEMOCRATIC = jaisi sarkar jismein people enjoy equal political rights, apne rulers elect karte hain aur unhe accountable (jimmedaar) banate hain. Sarkar kuchh basic rules ke anusaar chalti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Loktantra ka formula: barabar adhikaar + chunav + jimmedari. Janta sirf vote nahi deti — woh shaasak ko sawal bhi poochh sakti hai! Aur "basic rules ke anusaar" ka matlab: democracy ka matlab bina rules ke danga nahi — sab samvidhan ke andar chalta hai. Chunav ke din sab barabar — ameer, gareeb, har caste, har dharm!

text: Preamble mein kitne key terms hain (Sovereign se Republic tak)?
ans: 5 — Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic
explanation: Preamble ke 5 key descriptive terms: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic — yeh sab Bharat ke roop ko dikhate hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yaad rakhne ka trick: S-S-S-D-R! Sovereign (khud-mukhtar), Socialist (samaj mein daulat ki baant), Secular (dharm-neutral), Democratic (janta ka raj), Republic (chuna hua pramukh). Pehle 3 ka relation samvidhan ke nature se, doosre 2 governance ke roop se. Aur in 5 ke baad 4 aur values aati hain — Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity — agle page par!

text: REPUBLIC ka kya matlab hai?
options: Raja ka uttaradhikari desh ka pramukh hota hai
Desh ka pramukh (head of the state) ek chuna hua vyakti hota hai, virasat mein mila hua nahi
ans: Desh ka pramukh (head of the state) ek chuna hua vyakti hota hai, virasat mein mila hua nahi
explanation: REPUBLIC = desh ka pramukh (head of the state) ek elected person (chuna hua vyakti) hai, hereditary (virasat mein mila hua) position nahi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: British system mein raja/rani virasat se aata hai — woh monarchy hai. Bharat mein Rashtrapati chuna jaata hai (MPs aur MLAs dwara) — koi virasat ka hak nahi! 26 January 1950 ko hi Bharat ganatantra (republic) bana tha. Crossword clue: "A system where the head of state is elected, not hereditary" — jawab REPUBLIC!

text: Preamble ka text kisne likha aur samvidhan mein kaisa dikhata hai?
options: Calligraphy mein haath se likha gaya — ek kala-kriti ke roop mein
ans: Calligraphy mein haath se likha gaya — ek kala-kriti ke roop mein
explanation: Preamble ka text calligraphy mein haath se likha gaya — aur p17 ke chitron mein dekh sakte ho ki original samvidhan mein yeh ek kala-kriti (work of art) ke roop mein hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: P.15 par pada tha: Prem Behari Narain Raizada ne poora text haath se likha, Nandalal Bose ki team ne chitra banaye. Preamble ka page iska sabse sundar example hai — Value + Art ek saath! Isi liye original Constitution ko helium case mein itni hifazat se rakha gaya hai — kanoon bhi, itihaas bhi, kala bhi!

text: SOVEREIGN aur DEMOCRATIC mein kya farak hai?
options: Sovereign = koi bahari taakat aadesh nahi de sakti; Democratic = janta apne shaasak chunti hai aur unhe jimmedaar banati hai
Dono ek hi baat ke do naam
ans: Sovereign = koi bahari taakat aadesh nahi de sakti; Democratic = janta apne shaasak chunti hai aur unhe jimmedaar banati hai
explanation: SOVEREIGN = bahari taakaton se azaad (no external power dictates); DEMOCRATIC = janta ke haath mein power (equal political rights, elected rulers, accountability). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Dono alag pehlu hain: Sovereignty "bahar se" ki azaadi hai, Democracy "andar se" janta ka raj. Ek desh theoretically sovereign ho sakta hai par democratic nahi (jaise dictatorship — koi bahari taakat nahi, par janta ka adhikaar bhi nahi). Bharat dono hai — aur isi liye hum "Sovereign Democratic Republic" hain!

ruleTitle: PAGE 17 — Preamble — Har Sherd ka Matlab, Bhag 2: JUSTICE se FRATERNITY (PDF p.17 jari)
conceptText: • JUSTICE (Nyay) — Nagrikon ko caste, dharm aur gender ke aadhar par bhed-bhav nahi kiya ja sakta. Saamajik asamaataayein kam ki jaana chahiye. Sarkar sabke kalyaan ke liye kaam kare — khaaskar kam-advantage wale samuhon (less advantaged groups) ke liye. • LIBERTY (Svatantrata) — Nagrikon par koi anuchit (unreasonable) rok nahi honi chahiye — unke vichaaron par, unke vichaar vyakt karne ke tareeke par, aur unke vichaaron ko karne mein (action). • EQUALITY (Samanta) — Sab kanoon ke saamne barabar hain. Saamajik asamaataon ko khatam kiya jaana chahiye. Sarkar sabke liye barabar mauka (equal opportunity) ensure kare. • FRATERNITY (Bhaichara) — Hum sab aise vyavhaar karein jaise hum ek hi parivaar ke sadasy (members) hain. Koi apne saathi nagrik ko kamtar (inferior) na samjhe. ((Note: Preamble mein SOCIALIST aur SECULAR shabd 42nd Constitutional Amendment, 1976 ke through jode gaye the.))

text: Preamble mein JUSTICE ka kya matlab hai?
options: Caste, dharm aur gender ke aadhar par koi bhed-bhav nahi; saamajik asamaataayein kam hon; sarkar sabke kalyaan ke liye kaam kare — khaaskar kam-advantage wale samuhon ke liye
ans: Caste, dharm aur gender ke aadhar par koi bhed-bhav nahi; saamajik asamaataayein kam hon; sarkar sabke kalyaan ke liye kaam kare — khaaskar kam-advantage wale samuhon ke liye
explanation: JUSTICE = caste, dharm aur gender par discrimination nahi + saamajik asamaataon ki kami + sarkar sabke welfare ke liye — khaaskar less advantaged groups ke liye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Justice ka yeh concept bahut broad hai — sirf court-case nahi! Teen base par bhed-bhav mana: caste, dharm, gender. Aur welfare ka focus khaas taur par un par jo kam-advantaged hain — yehi social justice hai. Begum Aizaz Rasul ka quote (p.13) bhi isi se juda tha — women ko discrimination se bachana!

text: LIBERTY ka kya matlab hai (Preamble mein)?
options: Nagrikon par koi unreasonable restriction nahi — vichaaron par, unhe vyakt karne par, aur unhe action mein karne par
ans: Nagrikon par koi unreasonable restriction nahi — vichaaron par, unhe vyakt karne par, aur unhe action mein karne par
explanation: LIBERTY = no unreasonable restrictions — na sochne par (what they think), na vichaar vyakt karne par (how they express), na un vichaaron ko action mein karne par (how they follow up). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Liberty ka 3-step hai: socho → bolo → karo! Har step par unreasonable rok nahi honi chahiye. "Unreasonable" shabd important hai — reasonable restrictions ho sakte hain (jaise kisi ko nuksaan pahunchane wali baat nahi). 2004 ka jhanda faisla (p.15) isi liberty ka hissa tha — garv vyakt karna bhi expression hai!

text: EQUALITY ka kya matlab hai (Preamble mein)?
options: Sab kanoon ke saamne barabar; saamajik asamaataayein khatam hon; sarkar sabke liye barabar mauka ensure kare
ans: Sab kanoon ke saamne barabar; saamajik asamaataayein khatam hon; sarkar sabke liye barabar mauka ensure kare
explanation: EQUALITY = All are equal before the law + saamajik asamaataon ka ant + sarkar dwara sabko equal opportunity. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Samanta ke teen pehlu: (1) kanoon ke saamne (Article 14 — Equality before law), (2) samaj mein (discrimination ka ant), (3) mauke (jobs, shiksha mein barabari). Sirf kanoon mein likha hona kaafi nahi — samaj mein bhi asamaataan ka ant hona chahiye. Yehi constitutional goal hai!

text: FRATERNITY ka kya matlab hai?
options: Sab ek parivaar ke sadasyon jaise vyavhaar karein — koi apne saathi nagrik ko kamtar na samjhe
ans: Sab ek parivaar ke sadasyon jaise vyavhaar karein — koi apne saathi nagrik ko kamtar na samjhe
explanation: FRATERNITY = hum sab ek hi parivaar ke members ki tarah behave karein — koi apne saathi citizen ko inferior (kamtar) treat na kare. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fraternity ka arth: bhai-chara. Vasudhaiva kutumbakam (p.8 — duniya ek parivaar hai) ka constitutional version! Agar sab ek parivaar hain, toh caste-dharm ke naam par alag-thalag hona kaisa? Isliye fraternity samajik ekta ka sabse bada prateek hai. Jaise P.18 par example aayega — jobs mein sabko barabar mauka dena bhi isi se juda hai!

text: SOCIALIST aur SECULAR shabd Preamble mein kab jode gaye?
ans: 1976 — 42nd Constitutional Amendment se
explanation: Note: SOCIALIST aur SECULAR shabd Preamble mein 42nd Constitutional Amendment, 1976 ke through jode gaye the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh ek favourite exam fact hai! Original Preamble (1950) mein yeh do shabd nahi the — 1976 mein jud kar aaye. Aur mazedar baat: usi 42nd Amendment se Fundamental Duties (Part IV-A) bhi judi thi (p.15 par pada tha)! Ek amendment — do bade changes. Aur Panchayati Raj 73rd Amendment (1992) se aayi — teeno amendment numbers alag yaad rakho!

text: Preamble mein kitni values Justice se Fraternity tak aati hain?
ans: 4 — Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity
explanation: Chaar values: JUSTICE, LIBERTY, EQUALITY, FRATERNITY — yeh France se aaye ideals hain (liberty-equality-fraternity, p.9 par pada tha!). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: J-L-E-F yaad rakho! Aur connection dekho: France ke samvidhan se yeh teen shabd aaye the (liberty, equality, fraternity) — Bharat ne Justice ko unke saath joda. Aisa mat sochna ki yeh sirf English words hain — inka hindi roop bhi hai: Nyay, Swatantrata, Samanta, Bhaichara. Dono languages mein yaad karo!

text: Justice mein "less advantaged groups" ka kya role hai?
options: Sarkar khaaskar unke kalyaan ke liye kaam kare — kyunki unhe zyada zaroorat hai
ans: Sarkar khaaskar unke kalyaan ke liye kaam kare — kyunki unhe zyada zaroorat hai
explanation: Preamble ke anusaar sarkar sabke welfare ke liye kaam kare — khaas taur par kam-advantage (less advantaged) samuhon ke liye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Simple si baat: jo pehle se peeche hain, unhe aage laane ke liye extra madad chahiye. Yehi welfare ka asli matlab hai — sabko barabar, par jise zyada zaroorat hai use zyada. Directive Principles (jaise Article 47 — nutrition aur public health) isi soch ke products hain. Justice = sirf barabar treatment nahi, fairness bhi!

text: Liberty aur Freedom of Expression ka kya rishta hai?
options: Vichaar vyakt karna liberty ka ek hissa hai — isi liye Supreme Court ne 2004 mein jhanda fehrana Freedom of Expression maana
Dono alag deshon ke shabd hain
ans: Vichaar vyakt karna liberty ka ek hissa hai — isi liye Supreme Court ne 2004 mein jhanda fehrana Freedom of Expression maana
explanation: Vichaar vyakt karna LIBERTY ka hissa hai — aur isi se Freedom of Expression juda hai (jaise 2004 ka jhanda faisla). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Liberty ka 3-step: socho, bolo, karo. Freedom of Expression doosra step (bolo) ka formal naam hai — jo Article 19 mein Fundamental Right hai. Supreme Court ne 2004 mein kaha ki jhanda fehrana bhi expression hai (p.15). Preamble ki values aur Fundamental Rights — do layers ek hi building ke!

text: "All are equal before the law" — yeh kahan se aata hai?
options: Preamble ki EQUALITY se — aur Article 14 (Right to Equality) se
ans: Preamble ki EQUALITY se — aur Article 14 (Right to Equality) se
explanation: Yeh line Preamble ki EQUALITY value se aati hai — aur isi ko Article 14 (Right to Equality — Equality before law) laagu karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Preamble + Article = values + enforcement ka combo! Preamble kehta hai ki sab barabar hain, Article 14 usse enforceable banata hai (court ja sakte ho). Aur questions mein (p.19) book poochegi: "All citizens in India are equal before the law — kya yeh fact hai?" Socho: kanoon mein haan, par samaj mein abhi bhi complete nahi — values ka safar jaari hai!

text: Fraternity kis sanskrit concept se milti hai?
options: Vasudhaiva kutumbakam — duniya ek parivaar hai
ans: Vasudhaiva kutumbakam — duniya ek parivaar hai
explanation: FRATERNITY vasudhaiva kutumbakam ("the world is one family") ke concept se milti hai — jo hamari sanskriti mein embedded hai (p.8-9). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh connection exam ka hidden gem hai! Vasudhaiva kutumbakam (sanskrit parampara) → FRATERNITY (Preamble). Bharatiya sabhyata ne pehle se hi socha tha ki poora vishwa ek kutumb (parivaar) hai. French Revolution ne liberty-equality-fraternity ko popular banaya, par hamari apni parampara mein bhi yeh bhaav hazaron saal se tha. East + West = Bhartiya Samvidhan!

ruleTitle: PAGE 18 — Preamble ko Rozana Zindagi mein Dekhna + Before We Move On (PDF p.18)
conceptText: 📌 LET US EXPLORE — Preamble ko rozana dekhna Neeche Preamble mein diye gaye features ki list hai. Upar ki tasveer (Fig 10.16) se inhe dhyaan se padho aur roz ki zindagi mein in values ke prayog (application) ke examples likho. Exercise mein madad ke liye do pehle se complete kar diye gaye hain: Preamble ke Features | Humein roz ki zindagi mein kaise dikhte hain Sovereign + Secular | Ek vyakti ko apne dharm ke rituals karne ke liye State se ijaazat lene ki zaroorat nahi — agar us practice se kisi doosre ki rozana zindagi mein dakhal-andaaji nahi hoti. Republic + Justice | State jobs mein sabko barabar mauka deti hai — gender, caste, religion aadi se bhed-bhav ke bina . Liberty | (Aap likho...) Equality | (Aap likho...) Fraternity | (Aap likho...) 📌 BEFORE WE MOVE ON — Is chapter ka nichod • Bhartiya Samvidhan ek margdarshak kitab ya "rulebook" hai jo sabhi nagrikon ke adhikaaron ki raksha karta hai. Nagrikon se bhi ummeed ki jaati hai ki woh samvidhan ke fundamental duties ka paalan karein. • Bharat ki ameer sabhyata-virasa, swatantrata sangharsh aur doosre deshon ke samvidhanon ki achhi practices — yeh teeno Bhartiya Samvidhan ki building blocks rahi hain. • Iski mukhya visheshtaayein des ki saamajik, aarthik aur raajnitik sanrachna (structure) aur iski sansadiya (parliamentary) shasan-pranali ko define karti hain. • Yeh ek jeevit document hai jo desh ki zarooraton ke anusaar sudhaar (improved) kiya ja sakta hai.

text: LET US EXPLORE activity mein kya karna hai?
options: Preamble ke features ko roz ki zindagi ke examples ke saath jodna
ans: Preamble ke features ko roz ki zindagi ke examples ke saath jodna
explanation: Activity: Preamble ke features padho aur daily life mein in values ke application ke examples likho — do pehle se diye gaye hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh activity values ko abstract se practical banati hai! Sovereign+Secular ka example: "kisi ko apne dharm ke rituals ke liye State se ijaazat nahi lene padti." Republic+Justice ka example: "jobs mein sabko barabar mauka — gender, caste, religion se bhed-bhav ke bina." Aap Liberty, Equality, Fraternity ke examples khud socho — values tabhi samajh aati hain jab unhe apni zindagi mein dekhna shuru karo!

text: Sovereign aur Secular ka daily-life example kya hai (book mein diya gaya)?
options: Sabko ek dress pehni padti hai
Ek vyakti ko apne dharm ke rituals karne ke liye State se ijaazat lene ki zaroorat nahi — jab tak kisi doosre ki zindagi mein dakhal-andaaji nahi hoti
Sabko ek hi school mein jaana padta hai
ans: Ek vyakti ko apne dharm ke rituals karne ke liye State se ijaazat lene ki zaroorat nahi — jab tak kisi doosre ki zindagi mein dakhal-andaaji nahi hoti
explanation: Book ka example: kisi vyakti ko apne dharm ke rituals karne ke liye State se permission lene ki zaroorat nahi — jab tak us practice se kisi doosre ki day-to-day zindagi par dakhal-andaazi na ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Is example mein dono values ka combo hai: Sovereign (State ke control se azaad) + Secular (dharm ki free choice). Par condition bhi hai — kisi doosre ke rights par asar nahi hona chahiye! Yeh balance hi asli secular democracy hai: aapki azaadi tab tak hai jab tak doosre ki azaadi kharab nahi hoti!

text: Republic aur Justice ka daily-life example kya hai (book mein diya gaya)?
options: State jobs mein sabko barabar mauka deti hai — gender, caste, religion aadi ke bhed-bhav ke bina
ans: State jobs mein sabko barabar mauka deti hai — gender, caste, religion aadi ke bhed-bhav ke bina
explanation: Book ka example: State jobs mein sabko equal opportunity milti hai — chaahe koi bhi gender, caste ya religion ka ho. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Republic (chune hue pramukh wala system) + Justice (bhed-bhav nahi) — dono is example mein hain! Government jobs ke liye apply karne par sabka same process hai, koi caste-gender-dharm ka filter nahi. Yehi Article 14-16 (equality of opportunity) ka amal hai. Values sirf kanoon ki kitab mein nahi — roz ke opportunities mein dikhni chahiye!

text: BEFORE WE MOVE ON ke anusaar samvidhan kis tarah ki kitab hai?
options: Ek margdarshak kitab ya rulebook jo sabhi nagrikon ke adhikaaron ki raksha karta hai
ans: Ek margdarshak kitab ya rulebook jo sabhi nagrikon ke adhikaaron ki raksha karta hai
explanation: Summary: samvidhan ek guiding book ya rulebook hai jo sabhi nagrikon ke rights ki raksha karta hai — aur nagrikon se bhi fundamental duties ka paalan expected hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh chapter ka pehla point bhi yahi tha — kabaddi ka rulebook! Chapter circle complete hua: shuru mein rulebook, ant mein bhi rulebook. Aur dono baatein saath: rights ki raksha + duties ka paalan. Ek sided nahi — dono taraf ka contract hai nagrik aur samvidhan ke beech!

text: Bhartiya Samvidhan ki building blocks kya thi (summary ke anusaar)?
options: Bharat ki ameer sabhyata-virasa + swatantrata sangharsh + doosre deshon ke samvidhanon ki achhi practices
ans: Bharat ki ameer sabhyata-virasa + swatantrata sangharsh + doosre deshon ke samvidhanon ki achhi practices
explanation: Building blocks: (1) Bharat ki ameer civilizational heritage, (2) freedom struggle, (3) doosre deshon ke samvidhanon ki achhi practices (good practices). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yehi to chapter ke "What Shaped the Constitution" section ka nichod tha! Teen blocks — apni virasa (gurukula, vasudhaiva kutumbakam), sangharsh ke values (samanta, nyay), aur videshi seekh (France, Ireland, USA). Exam mein "three influences" poocha jaata hai — summary ne perfectly bata diya!

text: Samvidhan ki mukhya visheshtaayein kya define karti hain (summary ke anusaar)?
options: Desh ki saamajik, aarthik aur raajnitik sanrachna aur iski parliamentary shasan-pranali
ans: Desh ki saamajik, aarthik aur raajnitik sanrachna aur iski parliamentary shasan-pranali
explanation: Key features des ki social, economic aur political structure aur parliamentary form of government ko define karti hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Parliamentary system = jismein sarkar Parliament ke responsible hoti hai (PM aur council of ministers — p.12 par pada tha). Social + economic + political — teeno pehluo mein samvidhan rules deta hai. Yeh chapter ke Key Features section ka nichod hai — organs, rights, duties, DPSP sab isi mein aate hain!

text: Summary ke anusaar samvidhan kaisa document hai?
options: Jeevit document — jo desh ki zarooraton ke hisaab se improved kiya ja sakta hai
ans: Jeevit document — jo desh ki zarooraton ke hisaab se improved kiya ja sakta hai
explanation: Summary ka aakhri point: samvidhan ek living document hai jo desh ki zarooraton ke anusaar improved kiya ja sakta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh p.15 wale "Living Document" section ka nichod hai! Amendments (jhanda 2004, Panchayati Raj 1992, Duties 1976) — sab isiliye possible hue kyunki Constitution badal sakta hai. 1950 se aaj tak yeh relevant hai (Big Question 4 ka jawab!) — kyunki woh saath-saath badalta raha hai!

text: Samvidhan ki raksha kiska hai aur kis se ummeed ki jaati hai duties ka paalan ho?
options: Raksha samvidhan nagrikon ke rights ki karta hai — aur nagrikon se hi duties ka paalan expected hai
ans: Raksha samvidhan nagrikon ke rights ki karta hai — aur nagrikon se hi duties ka paalan expected hai
explanation: Summary: samvidhan sabhi nagrikon ke rights ki raksha karta hai, aur nagrikon se bhi expected hai ki woh fundamental duties ka paalan karein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do-sided deal: samvidhan tumhari hifazat karega, tum uske farz nibhaoge. Rights aur Duties ek sikke ke do pehlu hain (Fig 10.14 infographic mein dono saath the!). Misaal: shiksha ka adhikaar (Article 21-A) + bachche ko shiksha dilana maa-baap ki duty — dono saath kaam karte hain!

text: Samvidhan ke "rulebook" wale concept ko kis story se samjhaya gaya tha?
options: Kabaddi ka rulebook — referee aur captains ne rulebook dekh kar vivad suljhaya tha
ans: Kabaddi ka rulebook — referee aur captains ne rulebook dekh kar vivad suljhaya tha
explanation: Chapter mein kabaddi ka rulebook story thi — jismein referee ne official rulebook nikal kar vivad settle kiya tha. Bas wahi concept desh ke level par samvidhan hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Rulebook story (p.3-4) ab poori tarah samajh aa chuki hogi: jaise kabaddi ke rules sab players ke liye same, waise samvidhan sab nagrikon ke liye same. Aur jaise referee + captains ne rulebook maan kar faisla kiya, waise desh mein bhi sab (sarkar, courts, nagrik) samvidhan ko final manyata dete hain. Chapter ka framing device hi yehi tha!

text: Roz ki zindagi mein Equality ke liye aap kaisa example likh sakte ho (LET US EXPLORE ke liye)?
options: School mein har bachche ko — ladka ho ya ladki, kisi bhi caste ya dharm ka — barabar mauka aur samman milna
ans: School mein har bachche ko — ladka ho ya ladki, kisi bhi caste ya dharm ka — barabar mauka aur samman milna
explanation: Misaal: school mein har bachche ko barabar mauka aur samman milna — gender, caste, dharm kuchh bhi ho — yeh EQUALITY ka daily-life application hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Book ne do examples diye the (Sovereign+Secular, Republic+Justice) — Liberty, Equality, Fraternity aapko likhne the! Equality ke liye school example behtareen hai: class mein sabko barabar, khel-kood mein sabko mauka, teacher ka sabke saath same vyavhaar. Value tabhi sach hoti hai jab roz ke chhote-chhote kaamon mein dikhe!

ruleTitle: PAGE 19 — Questions aur Activities — Revision Pack (PDF p.19)
conceptText:
Book ke ant mein yeh sawaal aur activities diye gaye hain — inka nichod yahan hai, taaki concepts revise ho sakein (apne jawab khud banao!): • Q1. "Constituent Assembly mein Bharat ke vividh backgrounds ke pratinidhi the." Aapke vichaar mein poore Bharat se diverse representatives hona kyun zaroori tha? • Q2. Neeche ke statements padho aur batao ki Constitution ki kaunsi key feature/value reflect hoti hai:
  • (a) Sheena, Rajat aur Harsh line mein khade hain — general elections mein apna pehla vote dene ke liye utaawle hain.
  • (b) Radha, Imon aur Harpreet ek hi school ke ek hi class mein padhte hain.
  • (c) Maa-baap ko bachchon ki shiksha ka intezaam karna chahiye (Parents must make arrangements for their children education).
  • (d) Sab caste, gender aur dharm ke log gaon ke kuye (well) ka istemal kar sakte hain.
• Q3. Kaha jaata hai ki "Bharat mein sab nagrik kanoon ke saamne barabar hain". Kya aapke vichaar mein yeh fact hai? Haan toh kyun, nahi toh kyun nahi? Apni reasoning (dalailein) banao. • Q4. Aapne seekha hai ki "Bharat hi woh des hai jisne shuruaat se hi universal adult franchise diya". Kya aap samjha sakte ho ki Bharat ne aisa kyun kiya? • Q5. Freedom struggle ne samvidhan ke banane ko kaise prerit (inspire) kiya? Aur Bharat ki sabhyata-virasa ne samvidhan ki kuchh mukhya visheshtaayein kaise inspire ki? Samjhao. • Q6. Kya aapke vichaar mein hum, samaj ke roop mein, samvidhan ke saare ideals haasil kar liye hain? Agar nahi, toh hum har ek nagrik kya kar sakte hain taaki desh in ideals ke aur kareeb jaaye? • Q7. Clues dhyaan se padho aur agle page ka crossword solve karo — Bhartiya Samvidhan ke important concepts kholne ke liye!

text: Q2(a) — Sheena, Rajat aur Harsh pehla vote dene ke liye line mein hain. Kaunsi value reflect hoti hai?
options: Universal adult franchise / Democratic — sabko vote ka adhikaar
ans: Universal adult franchise / Democratic — sabko vote ka adhikaar
explanation: Pehla vote — universal adult franchise (sab vyast nagrikon ko vote ka adhikaar) — jo democratic value ka roop hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Voting = democracy ka biggest ritual! Har adult — chaahe koi bhi ho — vote kar sakta hai. Yeh Q4 se bhi juda hai: Bharat ne shuruaat se hi universal adult franchise diya (1950 mein jab duniya ke kai deson mein nahi tha). Ek line mein teen alag naam (Sheena, Rajat, Harsh) — yeh diversity mein ekta (sab ek line mein) bhi dikha raha hai!

text: Q2(b) — Radha, Imon aur Harpreet ek hi class mein padhte hain. Kaunsi value?
options: Equality / Fraternity — alag naam-castes ke bachche ek saath padhna
ans: Equality / Fraternity — alag naam-castes ke bachche ek saath padhna
explanation: Alag-alag backgrounds (naam se pata chalta hai) ke bachche ek hi class mein — yeh equality aur fraternity (bhaichara) ko reflect karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek school, ek class, sab barabar — education mein equality ka sabse seedha example! Radha, Imon aur Harpreet — teen naam teen alag paramparon se, par ek hi classroom mein. Yeh "samajik asamaataon ka ant" (Preamble EQUALITY) ka chhota-roop hai. Aur classrooms hi sabse pehli jagah hain jahan children equality seekhte hain!

text: Q2(c) — Maa-baap ko bachchon ki shiksha ka intezaam karna chahiye. Kaunsi cheez?
options: Fundamental Duty — shiksha ke avsar dena (duty f, p.14)
Directive Principle jo court enforce kare
ans: Fundamental Duty — shiksha ke avsar dena (duty f, p.14)
explanation: Yeh Fundamental Duty (f) hai — maa-baap ya sanrakshak hone par 6-14 saal ke bachche ko shiksha ke avsar dena. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fig 10.14 ki duties list mein yeh saaf likha hai! Aur iska doosra pehlu — Article 21-A (Right to Education) — Fundamental Right hai. Ek hi concept dono jagah: bachche ka adhikaar + maa-baap ki duty. Exam mein isko confuse karke poocha jaata hai — Dhyan se: "parents must ensure education" = DUTY, "child has right to education" = RIGHT!

text: Q2(d) — Sab caste, gender aur dharm ke log gaon ka kuaan use kar sakte hain. Kaunsi value?
options: Equality / Justice — kisi ko discrimination nahi, sabko barabar access
ans: Equality / Justice — kisi ko discrimination nahi, sabko barabar access
explanation: Sabko gaon ke kuye ka barabar access — bina caste-gender-dharm ke bhed-bhav — yeh EQUALITY aur JUSTICE ka example hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kuaan gaon ka shared resource hai — agar kisi caste ko use karne se roka jaaye, toh yeh discrimination hai (Article 15 mein caste par discrimination mana hai). Preamble kehti hai "Citizens cannot be discriminated on the grounds of caste, religion and gender." Ek kuaan, sabka haq — chhoti cheez, badi value!

text: Q3 ke liye "sab nagrik kanoon ke saamne barabar" — kaunse article isse laagu karta hai?
ans: Article 14 — Equality before law
explanation: Article 14 — Equality before law — yeh Q3 ke statement ko constitutional roop deta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Lekin Q3 kehti hai: "socho, yeh fact hai ya nahi?" Yeh discussion question hai — kanoon mein haan (Article 14), par samaj mein kya har jagah yeh poori tarah laagu hai? Apne arguments banao: haan ki taraf — kanoon sabke liye same; nahi ki taraf — discrimination abhi bhi dikhta hai kahin-kahin. Dono paksh sochna — yehi critical thinking hai!

text: Q4 — Bharat ne shuruaat se hi universal adult franchise kyun diya (sochne wala sawaal)?
options: Kyunki freedom struggle ka ideal tha ki har vyakti barabar hai — bina bhed-bhav ke sabki awaaz count ho
ans: Kyunki freedom struggle ka ideal tha ki har vyakti barabar hai — bina bhed-bhav ke sabki awaaz count ho
explanation: Book ka ishara: freedom struggle ke ideals — sabki samanta, sabke liye nyay — hi iski nev the; har adult ki awaaz count honi chahiye, bina bhed-bhav ke. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1950 mein yeh badi baat thi! Duniya ke kai deson mein auraton ko ya gareebon ko vote nahi milta tha (Switzerland mein women ko federal vote 1971 mein mila). Bharat ne ek hi kadam mein sabko diya — kyunki sangharsh ne sikhaya tha ki har insaan barabar hai. Q4 "explain karo" kehta hai — answer: freedom struggle ki values + sabhyata ka ideal (sarve bhavantu sukhinah — sab ka kalyan)!

text: Q5 ke do hisse kaunse hain?
options: Freedom struggle se prerana + sabhyata-virasa se prerana — dono samvidhan ko kaise inspire karte hain
ans: Freedom struggle se prerana + sabhyata-virasa se prerana — dono samvidhan ko kaise inspire karte hain
explanation: Q5: (1) freedom struggle ne samvidhan ko kaise inspire kiya, (2) civilisational heritage ne key features ko kaise inspire kiya — dono explain karne hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Iska poora jawab to chapter ke middle sections mein hai! Freedom struggle se: samanta, nyay, freedom, fraternity ke values (p.7). Sabhyata-virasa se: vasudhaiva kutumbakam, sarve bhavantu sukhinah, duties par zor (p.8-9). Agar exam mein yeh 5-mark question aaye, inhi points ko examples ke saath likhna!

text: Q6 kya poochta hai?
options: Kya humne exams pass kar li
Kya samaj ne samvidhan ke saare ideals haasil kar liye — agar nahi, toh har nagrik kya kar sakta hai
ans: Kya samaj ne samvidhan ke saare ideals haasil kar liye — agar nahi, toh har nagrik kya kar sakta hai
explanation: Q6: kya hum samaj ke roop mein sab ideals haasil kar chuke hain? Agar nahi — toh har nagrik kya kar sakta hai desh ko ideals ke kareeb le jaane ke liye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh self-reflection wala sawaal hai! Jawab honest hona chahiye: poori tarah nahi — discrimination, asamaata abhi bhi kahin-kahin hai. Par har nagrik kar sakta hai: values aamaal karna (samanta, bhaichara), duties nibhana (paryavaran ki suraksha, shiksha), aur apne aap example ban na. Constitution ke sirf rules nahi — citizens ki effort se desh badalta hai!

text: Q7 (crossword) kis cheez ke baare mein hai?
ans: Bhartiya Samvidhan ke important concepts
explanation: Q7: agle page ka crossword — jismein Bhartiya Samvidhan ke important concepts chhupe hain, clues padh kar solve karna hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Crossword ek revision tool hai — clues concepts ke definitions hain! Agla page pura crossword hai: legislature, Preamble, amendment, helium — sab answers is chapter se. Fun fact: NCERT ki nayi kitabein aise interactive activities rakhti hain taaki revision khel-khel mein ho jaaye!

text: Q1 — Constituent Assembly mein diverse representatives kyun zaroori the?
options: Kyunki Bharat culturally diverse des hai — har region, pesha aur samaj ke logon ki awaaz samvidhan mein honi chahiye thi
Kyun ki British ne kaha tha
ans: Kyunki Bharat culturally diverse des hai — har region, pesha aur samaj ke logon ki awaaz samvidhan mein honi chahiye thi
explanation: Q1 ka ishara: Bharat bada aur culturally diverse des hai — isliye har region, profession aur social group ki awaaz samvidhan banane mein honi zaroori thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: P.6 par pada tha: Assembly ke 299 members India ke diverse regions, professions aur social groups ko represent karte the. Kyun? Kyunki jo samvidhan sabko chalana hai, usmein sabki awaaz honi chahiye — warna kisi ka hissa chhoot jaata! Aur diverse members ke beech debates se hi balanced samvidhan bana. Yehi Q1 ka asli jawab hai!

ruleTitle: PAGE 20 — Crossword — Samvidhan ke Concepts Ka Khel (PDF p.20)
conceptText: Agla page (PDF p.20) ek crossword puzzle hai jiska jawab is chapter ke concepts hain. Yahan Across aur Down ke clues unke jawaabon ke saath — best revision! 📌 Across (aarak mein) • The branch of government that makes laws — LEGISLATURE (kanoon banane wala organ). • The part of the Constitution that outlines the duties of citizens towards the country — FUNDAMENTAL DUTIES. • The highest court in India that protects the Constitution — SUPREME COURT. • A system where the head of state is elected, not hereditary — REPUBLIC. • The process by which the Constitution can be changed over time — AMENDMENT. 📌 Down (neeche) • The group of people who wrote the Indian Constitution — CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. • The statement at the beginning of the Constitution that tells us the values it upholds — PREAMBLE. • The document that lays out the rules and laws of a country — CONSTITUTION. • The gas used to preserve the original Constitution safely — HELIUM. • Basic rights given to every citizen, like freedom and equality — FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTS.

text: Crossword ke Across clue 2 ka jawab kya hai — "the branch of government that makes laws"?
ans: Legislature
explanation: Across 2: LEGISLATURE — sarkar ka woh organ jo kanoon banata hai (makes laws). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Crossword clues definitions ke roop mein hain — har clue ek concept ki definition hai! Legislature = kanoon banane wala. Yaad rakhne ka tarika: Legis = law (kanoon). Bharat mein Parliament (Lok Sabha + Rajya Sabha) aur state vidhayikayein legislature hain. Agar clue mein "makes laws" dikhe — jawab legislature!

text: Across clue 7 — "the part of the Constitution that outlines the duties of citizens towards the country"?
ans: Fundamental Duties
