explanation: Across 7: FUNDAMENTAL DUTIES — samvidhan ka woh hissa jo nagrikon ke desh ke prati farz bayan karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fundamental Duties = nagrik ke farz (jhanda ka samman, desh ki raksha, paryavaran ki suraksha, shiksha dilana...). NOTE: Yeh 1976 mein Part IV-A ke roop mein judi thi (p.15)! Clue mein "duties towards the country" — toh jawab Fundamental Duties, Preamble nahi (woh values batata hai, duties nahi).

text: Across clue 8 — "the highest court in India that protects the Constitution"?
ans: Supreme Court
explanation: Across 8: SUPREME COURT — Bharat ki sabse oonchi adalat jo samvidhan ki raksha karti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Supreme Court = nyaypaalika ka sabse ooncha star. Judiciary (p.12) yeh check karti hai ki saare kanoon samvidhan ke anusaar hon — aur yeh kaam Supreme Court apex level par karti hai. 2004 ka jhanda faisla bhi Supreme Court ka tha! Co-order yaad rakhna: SC protects, sarkar proposes, samvidhan decides!

text: Across clue 9 — "a system where the head of state is elected, not hereditary"?
ans: Republic
explanation: Across 9: REPUBLIC — jismein desh ka pramukh chuna jaata hai, virasat mein nahi milta. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Republic ka core test: elected head? Republic! Hereditary head? Monarchy (jaise Britain ka raja). Bharat mein Rashtrapati chuna jaata hai — isi liye hum "Republic" hain aur 26 January ko Republic Day manate hain (Constitution lagu hone ke din!). Republic + Democratic = democracy ke saath chuna hua pramukh!

text: Across clue 10 — "the process by which the Constitution can be changed over time"?
ans: Amendment
explanation: Across 10: AMENDMENT — woh prakriya jisase samvidhan samay ke saath badla ja sakta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: A + mend = sudhaar karna. P.15 ka poora page isi par tha! Fundamental Duties (1976), Panchayati Raj (1992 ke 73rd Amendment se) — sab amendments ke through aaye. Amendment ke liye Parliament mein rigorous debate chahiye (kuchh ke liye state assemblies mein bhi). Isi flexibility se Constitution living document hai!

text: Down clue 1 — "the group of people who wrote the Indian Constitution"?
ans: Constituent Assembly
explanation: Down 1: CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY — woh samuh jinhone Bhartiya Samvidhan likha tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Constituent Assembly 1946 mein bani thi (389 members, baad mein 299) — lagbhag 3 saal tak samvidhan par kaam kiya. Confusion alert: Drafting Committee sirf initial text taiyaar karne wali chhoti team thi (Ambedkar ki adhyakshatta mein); Constitution poora Constituent Assembly ne banaya — crosswise mein answer ASSEMBLY hi hai!

text: Down clue 3 — "the statement at the beginning of the Constitution that tells us the values it upholds"?
ans: Preamble
explanation: Down 3: PREAMBLE — samvidhan ki shuruaat ka bayan jo values batata hai (values it upholds). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Preamble = samvidhan ki aatma! WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA se shuru hokar Sovereign-Socialist-Secular-Democratic-Republic aur Justice-Liberty-Equality-Fraternity — sab values ek jagah. Crossword clue mein "statement at the beginning" — toh Preamble (Preface nahi — woh kitaabon ke liye hota hai!).

text: Down clue 4 — "the document that lays out the rules and laws of a country"?
ans: Constitution
explanation: Down 4: CONSTITUTION — woh document jo desh ke rules aur kanoon lay out karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh to isi chapter ki pehli definition hai (Grade 6 se!): "a document that lays down the basic principles and laws of a nation." Crossword mein "rules and laws of a country" — jawab Constitution. Poora chapter isi shabd ke ird-gird ghoomta hai — Rule 1 of the crossword: sab concepts ek doosre se jude hue hain!

text: Down clue 5 — "the gas used to preserve the original Constitution safely"?
ans: Helium
explanation: Down 5: HELIUM — woh gas jo mool samvidhan ko mehfooz rakhne ke liye use hoti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: P.2 se yeh fact! Helium inert gas hai — paper aur ink ke saath react nahi karti, isliye original Constitution Parliament mein helium-filled glass case mein rakha gaya hai. Chemistry + civics ka rare combo — isliye exam mein yeh odd fact favourite hai. Fig 10.2 mein yehi case dikhaya gaya tha!

text: Down clue 6 — "basic rights given to every citizen, like freedom and equality"?
ans: Fundamental Rights
explanation: Down 6: FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTS — har nagrik ko diye gaye moolbhoot adhikaar — svatantrata aur samanta jaise. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fundamental Rights = promises that must be kept (p.13)! Article 14 (Equality), Article 21 (Life/Liberty), 21-A (Education), Right against Exploitation — sab is chapter mein diye gaye the. Crossword mein "basic rights" — toh FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTS. Aur yaad rakho: yeh enforceable hain (court ja sakte ho), DPSP nahi!
